AI.findings: 1) 伪标签运行状态识别准确率达97.67%；2) 累计负荷损失减少8.84%；3) 平均氢储能荷电状态提升6.30个百分点；4) 供电失效转移概率降低21.94%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出将运行状态信息转化为自适应充放电决策的预警引导框架；2) 发展了一种融合无监督聚类与集成学习的运行状态识别方法；3) 建立了成本敏感健康指数与动态阈值的预警生成机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为风-光-氢多能源系统提供了可落地的储能管理方案，在挪威Rye微电网实测数据上验证了有效性；2) 显著降低缺电风险，提升系统供电可靠性；3) 框架具有通用性，可推广至其他含储能的清洁能源系统。

title: From Nudge to Retention: How Interface Design Interventions Reduce App Hopping Behaviour Through Perceived Task Efficiency
affiliations: , SVKM's NMIMS Deemed to be University - Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Jiwaji University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Nudge to Retention: How Interface Design Interventions Reduce App Hopping Behaviour Through Perceived Task Efficiency
detail.abstract: Purpose This study examines how three types of behavioural nudges — progress feedback nudges, continuity nudges, and attention/friction nudges affects app hopping behaviour in mobile application environments. It further explores perceived task efficiency as a mediating mechanism linking these nudges to app switching behaviour.MethodologyA quantitative cross-sectional survey was administered online to smartphone users who regularly engage with multiple mobile applications. Partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM) was used for data analysis.Findings All three nudge types — progress feedback, default continuity, and attention/friction — significantly reduce app hopping behaviour and positively enhance perceived task efficiency. Perceived task efficiency emerges as a strong and significant mediator across all three nudge-to-app-hopping paths. The model explains 56.7% of the variance in app hopping behaviour (R² = 0.567) and 47.2% in perceived task efficiency (R² = 0.472). All hypotheses (H1 to H6) are supported at p < 0.001.Implications Mobile application designers and UX practitioners should integrate default continuity features (e.g., in-app task completion, auto-save), progress feedback mechanisms (e.g., completion bars), and light-touch friction cues (e.g., confirmation prompts before exit) to enhance user retention, reduce disruptive app switching, and improve overall user experience.Originality /value This study is one of the first attempt to combine theory of nudge with already established information systems models (UTAUT2) in the context of mobile app switching. It proposes perceived task efficiency as a new intermediate variable between the nudge design of an interface and behaviour (app switching), providing a theoretically supported and practically applicable model.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了三种行为助推（进度反馈助推、连续性助推和注意力/摩擦助推）如何影响移动应用环境中的应用跳跃行为，并发现感知任务效率在其中起中介作用。所有三种助推均显著减少应用跳跃行为并提升感知任务效率，模型解释了应用跳跃行为56.7%的方差。
AI.research_question: 三种行为助推（进度反馈助推、连续性助推和注意力/摩擦助推）如何影响移动应用环境中的应用跳跃行为？感知任务效率是否在其中起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 移动用户频繁在多个应用之间切换（应用跳跃）会降低用户体验和任务效率，但目前缺乏将行为助推理论与信息系统模型相结合来解释这一现象的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为助推理论（Nudge Theory）与UTAUT2模型（统一技术接受与使用理论2）的结合。
AI.method: 定量横截面调查，通过在线问卷收集数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行分析。
AI.findings: 三种助推（进度反馈、默认连续性、注意力/摩擦）均显著减少应用跳跃行为并增强感知任务效率；感知任务效率在三种助推到应用跳跃行为路径中均起显著中介作用；模型解释应用跳跃行为56.7%的方差，感知任务效率47.2%的方差；所有假设均在p<0.001水平上得到支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将行为助推理论与UTAUT2模型结合应用于移动应用切换情境，提出感知任务效率作为界面助推设计与应用跳跃行为之间的新中介变量，构建了理论支持且实践可用的模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移动应用设计师和UX从业者提供具体设计建议：集成默认连续性功能（如应用内任务完成、自动保存）、进度反馈机制（如完成进度条）和轻触式摩擦提示（如退出前的确认提示），以提升用户留存、减少应用切换并改善用户体验。

title: Stabilizing Token-Mediated Marketplaces through Closed-Loop Reserve Funds and Dynamic Supply Locking
affiliations: Hanoi University of Science and Technology and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Stabilizing Token-Mediated Marketplaces through Closed-Loop Reserve Funds and Dynamic Supply Locking
detail.abstract: Token-mediated digital marketplaces increasingly use native tokens as payment, incentive, liquidity, and governance instruments. In these environments, token-price instability is not merely a speculative financial risk: it can affect service affordability, supplier reward value, liquidity participation, treasury capacity, and platform trust. This paper studies native-token instability as a transaction-infrastructure risk and proposes a closed-loop Stabilization Reserve Fund (SRF) as a cost-aware marketplace-governance mechanism. The SRF combines reserve-funded feedback intervention, volatility-triggered locking of eligible supply, intervention safeguards, and a dynamic reserve-refilling transaction tax. Unlike algorithmic peg mechanisms, it does not target a fixed price. Instead, it aims to dampen short-horizon downside stress while preserving long-run market price discovery. We evaluate the SRF through engineered crash simulations, controller ablations, Burn-and-Mint-Equilibrium regime stress tests, historical token-panel replay, eligible-supply sensitivity analysis, and explicit economic cost accounting. To connect token-market stabilization with electronic-commerce outcomes, we further translate price-path effects into marketplace-facing proxy indices for service affordability, supplier reward purchasing power, treasury intervention burden, and liquidity-access burden. In the benchmark engineered-crash setting with the upper-bound eligible-supply configuration (θ = 1.00), the Full SRF reduces rolling 14-day drawdown by 17.6%, worst one-day loss by 18.6%, and global maximum drawdown by 22.5% relative to no intervention. Under a more practical partial opt-in configuration (θ = 0.50), rolling drawdown reduction remains 11.8%. The results indicate that SRF is best understood not as a universal solution to token volatility, but as a tunable governance instrument for token-mediated marketplaces. Its benefits arise from improved short-horizon downside protection and reserve management, while its costs appear through transaction taxation, temporary liquidity restrictions, reserve utilization, intervention turnover, and price-discovery distortion. The paper contributes a decision framework for marketplace operators to evaluate when stabilization benefits justify user-facing governance costs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代币中介数字市场中原生代币价格不稳定的问题，提出了一种闭环稳定储备基金（SRF）作为市场治理机制。SRF通过储备资金反馈干预、波动触发的合格供应锁定、干预保障措施和动态储备补充交易税来平抑短期下行压力，同时保留长期市场价格发现功能。研究表明，SRF在减少最大回撤和短期损失方面效果显著，但也是一把双刃剑，需要权衡稳定收益与治理成本。
AI.research_question: 代币中介数字市场中，原生代币价格不稳定如何影响交易基础设施？如何设计一个成本感知的市场治理机制来缓解这种不稳定？
AI.motivation: 代币中介市场中，代币价格不稳定不仅是投机性金融风险，还会影响服务可负担性、供应商奖励价值、流动性参与、国库能力和平台信任，因此需要有效的治理机制来管理这种基础设施层面的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭环稳定储备基金（SRF）理论，结合储备资金反馈干预、波动触发的供应锁定、干预保障和动态税收机制，区别于传统算法挂钩机制（不追求固定价格，而是平抑短期波动）。
AI.method: 工程崩溃模拟、控制器消融实验、Burn-and-Mint-Equilibrium制度压力测试、历史代币面板回放、合格供应敏感性分析、显性经济成本核算，以及将价格路径效应转换为面向市场的代理指数。
AI.findings: 在基准工程崩溃场景中，完全SRF（θ=1.00）将滚动14天回撤降低17.6%，最差单日损失降低18.6%，全局最大回撤降低22.5%；部分参与配置（θ=0.50）下滚动回撤仍降低11.8%。SRF并非普遍解决方案，而是可调谐的治理工具，其收益来自短期下行保护，成本来自交易税、流动性限制和价格发现扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 将代币价格不稳定概念化为交易基础设施风险，并提出SRF作为成本感知的市场治理机制，为代币中介市场的稳定化提供了理论框架和可调谐的设计空间。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场运营者提供了评估稳定化收益与用户治理成本的决策框架，以及可落地的SRF机制设计参数（如合格供应比例θ的调谐）。

title: From Volume to Identity: Identity-based Forestry and the Future of High-resolution Environmental Governance

detail.title: From Volume to Identity: Identity-based Forestry and the Future of High-resolution Environmental Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Illegal timber laundering persists globally despite advances in satellite monitoring, certification systems, and increasingly sophisticated forest governance architectures. This paper argues that the persistence of illegal forest extraction is not explained solely by weak enforcement, corruption, or insufficient monitoring technologies, but also by a structural limitation embedded within contemporary forest governance itself. Current systems remain predominantly organized around volumetric abstraction, in which forests are regulated through aggregated inventories, authorized balances, and statistical reconciliation mechanisms rather than through persistent ecological identity continuity.
The paper introduces the concept of Identity Collapse to describe the progressive loss of verifiable biological linkage when individual trees are transformed into fungible volumetric units across extraction, transportation, industrial processing, commercialization, and environmental accounting systems. Under such conditions, timber legality increasingly depends on documentary compatibility and statistical coherence rather than on persistent ecological verification, creating structural conditions that facilitate substitution, laundering, and ecological anonymity within legal supply chains.
In response, this paper proposes a transition from volume-based forestry toward Identity-Based Forestry, operationalized through the proposed Tree-Level Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (TLMRV) framework. TLMRV is conceptualized as an interoperable ecological identity architecture designed to preserve verifiable linkage between biological origin, material flow, carbon accounting, and regulatory verification systems throughout the forest governance lifecycle.
The paper further argues that the implications of identity-based governance extend beyond timber legality into broader domains of climate governance, carbon integrity, ESG accountability, biodiversity verification, environmental due diligence, and high-resolution environmental governance systems. As climate economies become increasingly data-intensive, environmental trust may progressively depend on stronger forms of ecological continuity, permanence verification, traceability persistence, and auditable environmental authenticity.
Ultimately, this paper argues that the future credibility of forest governance may depend not only on improving environmental measurement accuracy, but on preserving the continuity of the ecological identities from which environmental value itself emerges.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前森林治理依赖"体积抽象"（将树木转化为可互换的体积单位），导致生态身份断裂，使得非法木材洗白成为可能。作者提出"身份崩塌"概念，并倡导从基于体积的林业转向"基于身份的林业"，通过树木级监测、报告与验证（TLMRV）框架，在森林治理全生命周期中保持生物起源、物质流动、碳核算与监管验证之间的可追溯关联。
AI.research_question: 为什么非法木材洗白在卫星监测、认证系统和森林治理架构不断进步的情况下依然持续存在？如何从根本上解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将非法采伐归因于执法薄弱、腐败或监测技术不足，但作者认为森林治理体系本身存在结构性缺陷——即基于体积抽象的治理方式使树木失去生态身份连续性，为非法木材混入合法供应链创造了结构性条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份崩塌（Identity Collapse）；基于身份的林业（Identity-Based Forestry）；树木级监测、报告与验证（TLMRV）；生态身份连续性；体积抽象治理。
AI.method: 概念性理论建构，通过对现有森林治理体系的结构性分析，提出"身份崩塌"概念，并设计TLMRV框架作为解决方案。
AI.findings: 非法木材洗白的持续存在不仅是执法和监测问题，更是森林治理体系基于体积抽象的结构性缺陷所致；木材合法性日益依赖文件兼容性和统计一致性，而非持续的生态验证，这为替代、洗白和生态匿名创造了条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"身份崩塌"这一新概念，揭示森林治理中生态身份丧失的结构性机制；将治理分析从"测量准确性"转向"生态身份连续性"这一更根本的维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出TLMRV框架，为森林治理、碳核算、ESG问责、生物多样性验证等提供可操作的身份追踪架构；对气候治理、碳信用完整性、环境尽职调查等实践领域具有直接指导意义。

title: A Rule-Based Borrower Screening Framework for Digital Agricultural Lending: A Case Study of Remote Credit Decisioning in Kazakhstan

detail.title: A Rule-Based Borrower Screening Framework for Digital Agricultural Lending: A Case Study of Remote Credit Decisioning in Kazakhstan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on a practice-oriented case study of a digital lending system. No personal borrower-level data, human-subject experimentation, or identifiable participant information were used in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a case study of a rule-based borrower screening framework used in digital agricultural lending in Kazakhstan. The project was developed in collaboration with Agrarian Credit Corporation and focused on a real pre-screening system integrated into the Agrocredit mobile application and web portal. The system supports remote preliminary credit decisioning for agricultural producers by checking whether an application can move forward to the next stage of review. Unlike score-based models that use weighted coefficients, probability estimates, or risk bands, the framework described here follows a deterministic pass/fail logic. It uses rule-based conditions to process financial, legal, and registry-based information and convert these inputs into a structured preliminary classification result. The system does not make a final lending decision. Instead, it performs an early-stage screening step that either allows the application to proceed or blocks it until the detected issues are resolved. The paper explains the model's structure, the main categories of screening factors, the data sources used, and the practical decision logic implemented in the process. It also describes measurable operational results. According to the implementation context discussed here, preliminary screening that previously could take up to 15 days in an office-based process can now be completed automatically in about 2-5 minutes in the online channel. Initial documentation requirements have also been reduced, and approximately 80-90% of applications can be checked automatically at the pre-screening stage. The case is relevant not only for digital finance but also for applied mathematics in finance, because it shows how heterogeneous borrower-related variables can be formalized into a deterministic decision framework for real financial use.

AI.tldr: 本文通过哈萨克斯坦数字农业贷款案例，展示了一个基于规则而非评分模型的借款人预筛选框架。该系统集成于移动应用和网页端，将原本长达15天的线下预筛选流程缩短至2-5分钟，实现了80-90%申请的自动检查，采用确定性通过/拒绝逻辑处理财务、法律和登记信息。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于规则而非评分模型的确定性借款人预筛选系统，并将其应用于数字农业贷款场景？
AI.motivation: 传统农业贷款预筛选流程耗时（最多15天）、依赖线下办公，且需要大量文档材料，亟需自动化的数字解决方案提高效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 确定性通过/拒绝逻辑框架（Deterministic Pass/Fail Logic），基于规则的条件判断（Rule-based Conditions），非加权系数/概率估计/风险分段的评分模型。
AI.method: 与Agrarian Credit Corporation合作的案例研究，实施并评估集成了Agrocredit移动应用和网页门户的真实预筛选系统。
AI.findings: 系统将预筛选时间从15天缩短至2-5分钟；初始文档要求降低；80-90%的申请可在预筛选阶段自动检查。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了如何将异质性的借款人相关变量形式化为可用于实际金融场景的确定性决策框架，为数字金融中的应用数学提供了新案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字农业贷款提供了可落地的自动化预筛选方案；显著提升效率、降低成本；可作为其他新兴市场数字信贷系统的参考模板。

title: Data-driven Decision Making and Sales Growth In FMCG Companies In Bangladesh: A Conceptual Review And Research Agenda
affiliations: East West University and North South University

detail.title: Data-driven Decision Making and Sales Growth In FMCG Companies In Bangladesh: A Conceptual Review And Research Agenda
detail.abstract: This paper examines how data-driven decision making can support sales growth in fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies in Bangladesh. The manuscript is positioned as a conceptual review article rather than an empirical study. It synthesizes research on analytics capability, retail analytics, demand forecasting, promotion optimization, distribution execution, and organizational readiness, then interprets these insights in the context of Bangladesh's FMCG market. The review suggests that data-driven decision making affects sales growth through four linked mechanisms: stronger customer insight, better demand forecasting, more effective promotion decisions, and tighter distribution execution. The paper also argues that the sales effect of data is conditional rather than automatic. Data quality, managerial commitment, employee capability, and an analytical culture shape whether data is translated into timely commercial action. The article contributes in three ways. First, it consolidates fragmented literature into one Bangladesh-relevant framework. Second, it explains why the FMCG context requires fast, outlet-level, evidence-based decisions. Third, it proposes a research agenda for future empirical work in Bangladesh. The paper concludes that FMCG firms can improve sales growth when they move beyond routine reporting and use data as a decision infrastructure across forecasting, promotion, and route-to-market management.

AI.tldr: 本文通过概念性综述，构建了一个数据驱动决策影响孟加拉国快消品企业销售增长的理论框架，指出数据通过客户洞察、需求预测、促销优化和分销执行四个机制发挥作用，且这一效应受到数据质量、管理层承诺、员工能力和分析文化等条件的调节。
AI.research_question: 数据驱动决策如何支持孟加拉国快消品企业的销售增长？
AI.motivation: 尽管数据驱动决策在商业中日益重要，但针对孟加拉国等新兴市场快消品行业的研究尚不充分，缺乏整合性的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分析能力、零售分析、需求预测、促销优化、分销执行、组织准备度等相关文献的综合框架。
AI.method: 概念性综述（Conceptual Review），非实证研究，综合已有文献并在孟加拉国情境下进行解读。
AI.findings: 数据驱动决策通过四种机制（客户洞察、需求预测、促销决策、分销执行）影响销售增长，但这种影响是有条件的，取决于数据质量、管理层承诺、员工能力和分析文化。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）整合碎片化文献，构建与孟加拉国相关的研究框架；（2）解释快消品行业为何需要快速、门店级、基于证据的决策；（3）提出未来实证研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 快消品企业应超越常规报告，将数据作为决策基础设施应用于预测、促销和渠道管理中，从而提升销售增长。

title: Trust equilibrium theory
affiliations: Edith Cowan University

detail.title: Trust equilibrium theory
detail.abstract: Online payment security is designed to mitigate fraudulent transaction, yet hyper-engineered security parameters routinely introduce user experience friction, that precipitates shopping cart abandonment at the payment stage. This study draws upon the microeconomic foundations of demand and supply equilibrium to conceptualise and test "Trust Equilibrium Theory". The theory examines the trade-offs between transaction security, user convenience, and consumer trust. This study implements an experimental simulation which models real-time online checkout behaviours across multiple security thresholds. We apply survival analysis, specifically Kaplan-Meier estimators and Cox proportional hazards regressions, to evaluate the time-to-event dynamics of transaction abandonment. Our results reveal an intricate relationship. While standalone security increments can suppress conversions, the interaction effect between trust signals and transaction convenience significantly buffers attrition, yielding a 26% reduction in abandonment risk. Crucially, we identify a counter-intuitive behaviour among digitally proficient users, who exhibit a significantly higher rate of transaction abandonment when subject to redundant security protocols. These findings offer actionable empirical frameworks for platform architects and e-commerce merchants to dynamically optimise security architectures without increasing transaction attrition rate.​

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信任均衡理论"，通过实验模拟和生存分析发现，安全验证与用户便利性的交互效应可将交易放弃风险降低26%，且数字素养高的用户对冗余安全协议更易放弃交易。
AI.research_question: 在线支付安全参数如何影响用户交易放弃行为？信任信号与交易便利性的交互作用能否缓冲安全升级带来的负面效应？
AI.motivation: 过度设计的支付安全措施虽然旨在防范欺诈，但造成了用户体验摩擦，导致支付阶段购物车放弃率升高。现有文献缺乏对安全、便利与信任三者间权衡关系的系统理论解释和实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任均衡理论（Trust Equilibrium Theory），基于微观经济学的供需均衡基础，探讨交易安全、用户便利性与消费者信任之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 实验模拟法，模拟真实在线结账行为，设置多种安全阈值；采用生存分析中的Kaplan-Meier估计量和Cox比例风险回归模型评估交易放弃的时间动态。
AI.findings: 1. 单独提高安全级别会抑制转化；2. 信任信号与交易便利性的交互效应显著缓冲放弃行为，使放弃风险降低26%；3. 数字素养高的用户在面对冗余安全协议时表现出更高的交易放弃率（反直觉发现）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并实证检验"信任均衡理论"，为理解安全-便利-信任三者权衡提供了新的理论框架；揭示了不同用户群体（特别是数字素养高者）对安全协议的差异化反应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台架构师和电商商家提供了动态优化安全架构的实证框架，在不增加交易放弃率的前提下平衡安全性与用户体验。

title:
Automation and Scaling of OpenAPI Integrations:
 A Federated Solution
affiliations: , eBay Inc., eBay Inc., eBay Inc. and eBay Inc.

detail.title:
Automation and Scaling of OpenAPI Integrations:
 A Federated Solution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are employees of eBay Inc. and describe an internal software architecture and operational integration approach. No additional personal or financial conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper describes software architecture, API integration patterns, and operational engineering practices. It does not involve human subjects, patient data, animal studies, or clinical experimentation. Formal ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work. The manuscript was prepared as part of the authors’ work at eBay Inc.

detail.abstract:
OpenAPI specifications have become foundational for documenting and consuming REST
APIs, but large organizations still face significant friction when they try to scale those integrations
across many teams and services. Developers must retrieve and interpret specification files, generate
client code, configure authentication and retries, manage versioning, and keep implementations
aligned across distributed environments. This technical-report edition describes Orion Link,
a federated OpenAPI client gateway and managed hosted service designed to centralize those
tasks. Orion Link automates generated-client management, configuration, version transitions,
monitoring, and plug-and-play extensibility, while also supporting a sidecar model for lower-
latency paths. The article argues that a federated, centrally governed client layer can reduce
repetitive boilerplate, improve consistency, and simplify API consumption at enterprise scale.

title: A Digital Twin-Based Adaptive Optimization Framework for LNG Processes under Equipment Degradation
affiliations: Inha University, Inha University and Inha University

detail.title: A Digital Twin-Based Adaptive Optimization Framework for LNG Processes under Equipment Degradation
detail.abstract: The energy consumption of LNG liquefaction processes is strongly affected by coupled refrigerant compression, cryogenic heat exchange, expansion, recirculation, feed conditions, operating variables, and equipment performance. Therefore, an optimization framework is required that can update operating decisions as process conditions change and maintain model reliability under equipment degradation. This study proposes a degradation-aware digital twin-based AI optimization framework that collects process-consistent data from the digital twin, uses an ML surrogate model to propose optimal operating conditions, and updates the model under degradation. The calibrated digital twin, constructed using actual LNG operating data, reduced the average prediction error of key process variables from 3.24% to 0.78% and served as a reference environment for data generation and revalidation of optimized operating conditions. To maintain optimization applicability under process changes, the pretrained surrogate model was updated using limited degraded-process data through a layer-wise transfer learning strategy designed to preserve prediction accuracy and generalization performance. The updated surrogate model was evaluated on unseen degraded-process data and at optimized operating points reintroduced into the digital twin, verifying its reliability under changing operating and degradation scenarios. Finally, energy consumption was compared to assess process-level effectiveness. Compared with the existing operating strategy, the proposed framework achieved average energy savings of 1.51%, 1.66%, and 3.19% under normal, uniformly degraded, and locally degraded conditions, respectively. Under degradation, model updating provided additional savings of 1.12% and 3.76% compared with optimization using the non-updated surrogate model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于数字孪生的退化感知AI优化框架，用于LNG液化过程。该框架通过数字孪生收集数据、ML代理模型提出最优操作条件，并在设备退化时更新模型。在实际LNG数据上，关键变量预测误差从3.24%降至0.78%；相比现有策略，在正常、均匀退化和局部退化条件下分别节能1.51%、1.66%和3.19%。
AI.research_question: 如何在LNG液化过程中，在设备退化条件下实现操作决策的持续优化，以降低能耗？
AI.motivation: LNG液化过程的能耗受制冷压缩、低温换热、膨胀、循环、进料条件、操作变量和设备性能等多重耦合因素影响，且设备会随时间退化。现有优化框架无法在过程条件变化时持续更新操作决策，也无法在设备退化下保持模型可靠性，因此需要一种能感知退化并动态更新的优化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生（Digital Twin）、机器学习代理模型（ML Surrogate Model）、迁移学习（Transfer Learning，具体为逐层迁移学习策略）
AI.method: 1. 构建校准后的数字孪生模型（基于实际LNG运行数据）；2. 利用数字孪生生成过程一致的数据，训练ML代理模型；3. 通过逐层迁移学习策略，使用有限的退化过程数据更新预训练的代理模型；4. 将优化后的操作条件重新输入数字孪生进行验证；5. 比较能耗以评估过程级效果。
AI.findings: 1. 校准后的数字孪生将关键过程变量的平均预测误差从3.24%降至0.78%；2. 相比现有策略，正常、均匀退化、局部退化条件下分别节能1.51%、1.66%和3.19%；3. 在退化条件下，模型更新相比未更新的代理模型额外节省1.12%和3.76%的能耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了退化感知的数字孪生+AI优化框架，将设备退化纳入过程优化；2. 引入逐层迁移学习策略，使代理模型能在有限退化数据下保持预测精度和泛化能力；3. 建立了数字孪生用于数据生成和优化结果再验证的闭环框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为LNG液化过程提供了可落地、可动态更新的节能优化方案，在不同退化场景下均能有效降低能耗；2. 仅需有限的退化数据即可更新模型，降低了实际工业部署中的数据获取成本；3. 数字孪生的高精度校准（误差降至0.78%）表明该方法具有实际工业应用潜力。

title: AI-Agent Framework for Sales Risk Identification and Response in Live-Commerce Environments
affiliations: , Chung-Ang University, Chung-Ang University, GS Retail Co. Ltd and Korea University

detail.title: AI-Agent Framework for Sales Risk Identification and Response in Live-Commerce Environments
detail.abstract: Conventional rule-based approaches are widely used for analyzing customer evaluations in e-commerce and live-commerce environments. However, these approaches often show limitations in detecting newly emerging product issues and prioritizing business-critical risks. To address these limitations, this study proposes an intelligent AI-agent framework for proactive product-risk identification and sales-response support. First, semantic embeddings generated using Sentence-Transformers are integrated with the HDBSCAN clustering algorithm to identify latent issue patterns and remove noisy evaluations. Subsequently, class-based term frequency-inverse document frequency is employed to extract representative keywords from clustered customer feedback. Based on the extracted information, the Llama large language model automatically generates product defect categories and issue descriptions. In addition, this study introduces a risk-scoring mechanism incorporating vote-related metadata to identify defect issues with high customer churn potential. The most influential defect category is further analyzed using aspect-level sentiment analysis to derive fine-grained customer sentiment patterns. Finally, the proposed framework automatically generates objection-response guidelines that can be directly utilized in live-commerce broadcasting and customer-response operations. The proposed framework demonstrates how large language models can be integrated into an automated decision-support architecture for proactive risk management in e-commerce environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AI智能体的框架，整合Sentence-Transformers、HDBSCAN聚类、Llama大语言模型等技术，用于电商直播环境中主动识别产品风险、生成缺陷类别、评估客户流失风险，并自动生成应对指南，弥补传统规则方法在新兴问题检测和风险优先级排序上的不足。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型和AI智能体框架，在电商与直播电商环境中实现主动的产品风险识别与销售响应支持？
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的方法在检测新出现的产品问题和优先排序业务关键风险方面存在局限性，需要更智能、更自动化的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义嵌入（Sentence-Transformers）、密度聚类（HDBSCAN）、类词频-逆文档频率（c-TF-IDF）、大语言模型（Llama）、风险评分机制、方面级情感分析。
AI.method: 1) 使用Sentence-Transformers生成语义嵌入，结合HDBSCAN聚类识别潜在问题模式并去除噪声；2) 采用c-TF-IDF提取代表性关键词；3) 利用Llama大语言模型自动生成产品缺陷类别和问题描述；4) 引入基于投票元数据的风险评分机制识别高客户流失风险；5) 对最具影响力的缺陷类别进行方面级情感分析；6) 自动生成可用于直播和客服的应对指南。
AI.findings: 该框架能有效识别潜在产品问题模式、自动分类缺陷、量化客户流失风险，并生成可直接用于直播电商和客户响应运营的异议应对指南。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将大语言模型集成到自动化决策支持架构中的方法，构建了面向电商环境的主动风险管理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商和直播电商平台提供了一套可落地的自动化产品风险识别与响应工具，能够直接生成用于直播和客服的应对话术，提升客户留存和运营效率。

title: From AI experimentation to operational capability: Governance routines and platform architectures for AI-first organizations
affiliations: Purdue University

detail.title: From AI experimentation to operational capability: Governance routines and platform architectures for AI-first organizations
detail.abstract: We develop the Sustained Alignment Framework (SAF), a governance-centered account of why artificial intelligence initiatives often fail to move from successful pilots to durable operational capability. Drawing on dynamic capabilities, strategic intelligence, and digital transformation literatures, we argue that failure is primarily organizational rather than technical. Analytic capability generates strategic value only when interpreted, evaluated, and institutionalized through coherent governance structures. SAF operationalizes AI strategy alignment through strategic fit, evaluative coherence, and durable value realization, while positioning the Strategic Intelligence Capability Stack (AI-SI-DT) as the architecture sustaining these dimensions across large-scale industrial platform enterprises and archival case-based research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持续对齐框架(SAF)，从治理视角解释了AI项目为何常从成功试点转向运营失败，认为根本原因在于组织而非技术层面。
AI.research_question: 为什么人工智能倡议常常从成功的试点项目无法过渡到持久的运营能力？
AI.motivation: AI项目从试点到规模化运营的失败率极高，现有研究多关注技术瓶颈，缺乏对组织治理因素的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论、战略情报理论、数字化转型文献，以及SAF框架（战略契合、评估连贯性、持久价值实现）和战略情报能力栈（AI-SI-DT）。
AI.method: 大规模工业平台企业的案例研究与档案研究。
AI.findings: 分析能力只有在通过连贯的治理结构被解释、评估和制度化时，才能产生战略价值；AI项目失败的首要原因是组织治理问题而非技术问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SAF框架，将动态能力、战略情报与数字化转型理论整合为统一的组织治理视角，解释了AI价值实现的制度路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了系统化的AI战略对齐评估工具，帮助管理者识别和解决从试点到规模化运营中的组织治理障碍。

title: Onboard autonomous mission planning: synergies and challenges of deep reinforcement learning and neural multi-objective optimization
affiliations: Bengbu University, Space Engineering University, Bengbu University, Bengbu University, Bengbu University and Chinese Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Onboard autonomous mission planning: synergies and challenges of deep reinforcement learning and neural multi-objective optimization
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of satellite constellations and space debris challenges traditional manual control. Onboard autonomous mission planning, powered by Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and Neural Multi-Objective Optimization (NMOO), offers a promising solution. DRL enables real-time decisions in dynamic environments, while NMOO balances conflicting goals like task priority and energy use. Despite significant progress, challenges remain in computational complexity, data quality, and real-time demands. This paper reviews recent advances, analyzes key challenges, and outlines future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了深度强化学习（DRL）与神经多目标优化（NMOO）在卫星星座自主任务规划中的应用，分析了其在动态环境中实时决策、平衡冲突目标（如任务优先级与能耗）方面的优势，并指出了计算复杂度、数据质量和实时性等挑战，最后展望了未来发展方向。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度强化学习与神经多目标优化实现卫星星座的自主任务规划，以应对卫星数量激增和空间碎片带来的控制挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统人工控制已无法适应卫星星座的快速增长与空间碎片的复杂环境，亟需发展自主化、智能化的任务规划方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度强化学习（DRL）、神经多目标优化（NMOO）
AI.method: 综述性研究，梳理近年来的技术进展，分析DRL与NMOO在卫星自主任务规划中的应用现状与挑战。
AI.findings: DRL能实现动态环境下的实时决策；NMOO可有效平衡任务优先级与能耗等多重冲突目标；但仍面临计算复杂度高、数据质量要求高、实时响应压力大等关键挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统总结了DRL与NMOO在卫星自主规划中的联合应用现状，识别了当前技术瓶颈，为后续理论创新提供方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卫星星座自主运行系统的设计与优化提供了技术路线参考，有助于降低对地面人工控制的依赖，提升卫星任务执行的效率与鲁棒性。

title: Hub location–routing under demand uncertainty: A vertical integration perspective in maritime transportation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Nottingham and Nottingham University Business School

detail.title: Hub location–routing under demand uncertainty: A vertical integration perspective in maritime transportation
detail.abstract: Demand uncertainty plays a crucial role in hub location decisions since hub facilities represent long-term infrastructure investments. This paper studies a hub location–routing problem under demand uncertainty, motivated by the growing involvement of shipping lines in container terminal operations within maritime supply chains. The problem is formulated as a possibilistic mixed-integer linear program with imprecise origin–destination demands and transformed into an auxiliary crisp counterpart using a fuzzy measure-based chance constrained programming approach. To efficiently solve large-scale instances, we develop a Tabu Search algorithm and a decomposition heuristic that iteratively addresses three interrelated subproblems. Computational experiments based on real-world data from major Mediterranean container terminals demonstrate that the proposed methods obtain optimal or near-optimal solutions for instances with up to 56 nodes. The results also show that demand uncertainty can substantially influence hub investment decisions, network configuration, and total costs, highlighting the importance of explicitly incorporating uncertainty into strategic hub-and-spoke network design in maritime transportation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究需求不确定下的枢纽选址-路径问题，以航运公司参与集装箱码头运营为背景，提出模糊机会约束规划模型，开发禁忌搜索和分解启发式算法，通过地中海集装箱终端真实数据验证，发现需求不确定显著影响枢纽投资决策和网络配置。
AI.research_question: 需求不确定性如何影响海运供应链中集装箱枢纽的选址-路径决策？
AI.motivation: 枢纽设施是长期基础设施投资，需求不确定性对其选址决策至关重要；且航运公司越来越多地参与集装箱码头运营，实践中存在显著的需求不确定性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可能性混合整数线性规划；基于模糊测度的机会约束规划。
AI.method: 模糊机会约束规划转化模糊问题为确定性等价模型；禁忌搜索算法；分解启发式（迭代求解三个相互关联的子问题）；基于地中海主要集装箱终端的真实数据实验。
AI.findings: 所提方法能在56个节点实例中获得最优或近似最优解；需求不确定性会显著影响枢纽投资决策、网络配置和总成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模糊机会约束规划引入需求不确定下的枢纽选址-路径问题，为海运集装箱网络战略设计提供了不确定性建模框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航运公司在需求不确定环境下进行枢纽投资和网络设计提供了决策支持工具，建议在战略规划中明确纳入不确定性因素。

title: A Multiscale Optimization Framework for Real-World Transportation and Network Design Problems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Kassel, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Multiscale Optimization Framework for Real-World Transportation and Network Design Problems
detail.abstract: The rapid growth of global supply chains and the increasing availability of data have madelogistics optimization a critical yet increasingly complex challenge for industries worldwide. Solving transportation and network design problems is essential for optimizing supply chains, yet the complexity of real-world instances often renders direct optimization infeasible. In addressing this challenge, various aggregation schemes have been proposed, attempting to exploit hidden global structure and redundancies in the input data. While practically successful, these methods do no allow for interactivity in the optimization or interpretation of a solution, and have been applied to models with linear or convex cost structures. We propose a novel framework that dynamically aggregates and refines network data, tariffs, and demands, enabling the efficient transfer of feasible solutions across scales. In contrast to traditional approaches we employ a dynamic data structure enabling independent modification of the level of detail in different parts of the network. We customize our framework to a multi-commodity flow model with piecewise linear costs and a facility location model with delivery time constraints, incorporating diverse industry-specific aspects validated by experienced logistics professionals. The method is evaluated on real-world data from the automotive industry, provided by the supply chain consulting company 4flow. Results demonstrate significantly improved solution quality and, beyond computational performance,highlight the practical value of the approach through its support for explainability and interactivity: decision-makers can navigate between different levels of aggregation to better understand, validate, and communicate optimization outcomes, facilitating adoption in real-world supply chain planning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种动态聚合与细化的网络数据框架，能在不同粒度级别间高效传递可行解，支持可解释性和交互性，并在汽车行业真实数据上验证了显著改进的求解质量和实践价值。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种支持交互性和可解释性的动态聚合框架，以高效解决大规模供应链网络优化问题？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链快速增长和数据可用性提升使物流优化日益复杂，真实规模的实例往往难以直接优化；现有聚合方法虽在实践中成功，但缺乏交互性和可解释性，且仅适用于线性或凸成本结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态数据聚合与细化机制、多商品流模型（分段线性成本）、设施选址模型（交货时间约束）、可行解跨尺度迁移。
AI.method: 提出动态聚合与细化框架，采用动态数据结构实现网络不同部分独立修改粒度；针对多商品流模型和设施选址模型进行定制，通过汽车行业真实数据（4flow公司提供）进行验证。
AI.findings: 相比传统方法，所提框架显著提升了求解质量；支持决策者在不同聚合级别间导航，增强了优化结果的理解、验证和沟通能力，促进了实际供应链规划中的采纳。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种支持动态、非均匀聚合的数据结构，突破了传统方法仅适用于线性/凸成本结构的限制，将聚合方法推广到分段线性成本等更复杂的场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 在汽车行业真实数据上验证了方法有效性；通过支持交互性和可解释性，帮助决策者更好地理解和信任优化结果，提升了实际采纳率。

title: Specialisation as a Relational Condition: A Derivation of Firms and Markets
affiliations: InterAgency Institute

detail.title: Specialisation as a Relational Condition: A Derivation of Firms and Markets
detail.abstract: This paper develops an account of specialisation in which economic behaviour is understood as the evolved set of processes through which agents act on the probability of resource-services being available when and where wanted. Specialisation is treated as a relational condition in which an agent's range of direct productive activity is narrower than the range of their wants, sustained by relations with other agents whose activity is similarly concentrated on different ranges. The paper derives the structural requirements that deepening specialisation places on its two sides: firm-like organisation as the form through which sustained concentrated production is carried, and market institutions as the form through which distributional conversion at scale is supported. Firms and markets, on this account, are co-evolved elaborations of specialisation's two sides rather than parallel alternatives or sequentially prior arrangements. The paper engages with the classical, neoclassical, growth-theoretic, evolutionary, and transaction-cost traditions, and grounds its account in the trajectory of organisational and institutional forms documented in the anthropological, archaeological, and economic-history literatures.

AI.tldr: 本文从演化视角阐释专业化：经济行为是代理人对资源可得概率的主动作用过程。专业化是一种关系状态（代理人的直接生产活动范围窄于其需求范围），其深化要求企业（组织集中生产）与市场（支撑大规模分配转换）作为两面共同演化，而非替代或先后关系。文章综合古典、新古典、增长理论、演化和交易成本传统，并以人类学、考古学和经济史文献为实证基础。
AI.research_question: 专业化的本质是什么？企业组织和市场制度在专业化深化中扮演何种角色，二者之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 现有理论（古典、新古典、增长、演化、交易成本）对专业化、企业与市场的关系解释存在分歧，缺乏一个将专业化视为关系条件、并将企业与市场视为其共同演化产物的统一分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化视角下的专业化理论：专业化是代理人对资源服务可得概率的主动作用过程；专业化作为关系条件（生产范围<需求范围）；企业与市场是专业化深化的两个侧面的共同演化产物。
AI.method: 理论推导与跨学科文献综合（人类学、考古学、经济史）。
AI.findings: 专业化深化必然同时要求企业式组织（集中生产的载体）和市场制度（大规模分配转换的支持结构）；企业与市场不是平行的替代方案，也不是先后顺序的安排，而是专业化两个侧面的共同演化结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了将专业化视为关系条件的新分析框架；重新界定了企业与市场的关系（从替代/先后转向共同演化）；整合了古典、新古典、增长、演化和交易成本等多元理论传统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解企业组织形式和市场制度的共生发展提供历史与理论依据；对经济发展中专业化政策、产业组织设计具有启示意义。

title: AI Augmented Shipping Automation in ERP Systems:,Architecture, Algorithms, and Production Evaluation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: AI Augmented Shipping Automation in ERP Systems:,Architecture, Algorithms, and Production Evaluation

keywords.keywords: ERP shipping automation · Oracle EBS · carrier API integration · deep Q-network · reinforcement learning · BERT · LSTM · temporal fusion transformer · retrieval-augmented generation · anomaly detection · CUPS · ZPL · label generation

detail.abstract: Shipping label generation sits at the operational heart of order fulfilment in warehouse environments, yet in many Oracle ERP deployments it still depends on warehouse staff manually re-entering shipment data into carrier portals—a practice that is slow, error-prone, and increasingly incompatible with the throughput demands of modern e-commerce. This paper describes ShipSync-AI, an architecture we developed and deployed in a production Oracle E-Business Suite environment to eliminate that manual step and, beyond it, to embed genuine intelligence into the shipping decision process. The system has two layers. The first is a seven-component integration pipeline that automates end-to-end label generation through direct carrier API communication, with formal treatment of idempotent reprint handling, hierarchical printer resolution, return label support, and exponential-backoff error recovery. The second is an AI Intelligence Layer comprising six modules—a fine-tuned BERT address validator, an LSTM + gradient-boosted ETA predictor, a Deep Q-Network carrier selection agent, an Isolation Forest anomaly detector, a retrieval-augmented LLM exception handler, and a Temporal Fusion Transformer demand forecaster—each formally specified and individually benchmarked. The complete system was evaluated across 187,432 production shipments over 90 days. Manual processing effort fell by 82%, label accuracy reached 99.7%, throughput increased from 45 to 380 labels per hour, and P99 end-to-end latency measured 2.8 seconds. We also document the practical engineering challenges—ZPL resolution mismatches, API versioning transitions, concurrent staging table contention—that sit between a well-specified architecture and a working production deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ShipSync-AI架构，通过七组件集成管道和六模块AI智能层，在Oracle EBS环境中实现运输标签自动生成。生产部署90天/187,432单验证：人工处理减少82%，标签准确率99.7%，吞吐量从45提升至380标签/小时，P99延迟2.8秒。
AI.research_question: 如何在Oracle ERP仓库环境中，消除人工重新输入货运数据到承运商门户的手动步骤，并实现智能化的运输决策？
AI.motivation: 在Oracle ERP部署中，仓库人员仍需手动将货运数据重新输入承运商门户来生成运输标签，这种做法缓慢、易出错，且无法满足现代电商对吞吐量的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①集成管道架构设计（七个组件）；②AI智能层（BERT地址验证、LSTM+梯度提升ETA预测、Deep Q-Network承运商选择、隔离森林异常检测、检索增强LLM异常处理、时序融合Transformer需求预测）。
AI.method: ①七组件集成管道：实现端到端标签自动生成、幂等重印、分层打印机解析、退货标签支持、指数退避错误恢复；②六模块AI层：分别基于BERT、LSTM、深度强化学习、隔离森林、RAG-LLM、TFT等模型，各模块独立基准测试；③生产环境部署90天，覆盖187,432笔发货。
AI.findings: 人工处理减少82%，标签准确率达99.7%，吞吐量从45提升至380标签/小时，P99端到端延迟2.8秒。同时记录了ZPL分辨率不匹配、API版本迁移、并发暂存表争用等工程挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: ①提出双层次架构设计范式：集成管道+AI智能层的互补结构；②将多类AI模型（NLP、时序预测、强化学习、异常检测等）系统性地整合到运输标签生成这一具体工业场景中。
AI.practical_contributions: ①在真实Oracle EBS生产环境中成功部署并验证了智能标签生成系统；②提供了82%人力节省、99.7%准确率的量化效益证据；③记录了从设计到生产部署过程中的具体工程挑战与解决方案。

title: Quantum-inspired bi-level optimization for renewable-integrated vehicle-to-everything energy management in smart grids under uncertainty
affiliations: HUTECH University, Le Quy Don Technical University and HUTECH University

detail.title: Quantum-inspired bi-level optimization for renewable-integrated vehicle-to-everything energy management in smart grids under uncertainty
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a quantum-inspired bi-level optimization framework for renewable-integrated vehicle-to-everything (V2X) energy management in smart grids under uncertainty. The proposed framework simultaneously coordinates renewable generation, electric vehicle (EV) charging/discharging scheduling, vehicle-to-home (V2H), vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V), vehicle-to-grid (V2G) energy exchange, operational risk, and user satisfaction. A bi-level optimization model is developed in which the upper level minimizes load variance, electricity procurement cost, carbon emissions, and operational risk. In contrast, the lower level maximizes EV user profit and satisfaction. To solve the resulting nonlinear and stochastic optimization problem, a Quantum-inspired Energy Valley Optimizer (Q-EVO) is developed to improve convergence stability and exploration capability. Monte Carlo sampling is employed to model renewable generation and EV behavioral uncertainties. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework reduces load variance from 12,559.59 kW² to 8,705.60 kW² (30.69%), decreases system operating cost by 14.84%, reduces carbon emissions by 11.18%, and lowers peak net load by 19.96%. In addition, EV user satisfaction consistently remains above 0.99633 under all stochastic scenarios, confirming strong robustness and reliable user-level performance. Comparative results further demonstrate that the proposed Q-EVO provides superior optimization performance and convergence behavior compared with benchmark metaheuristic algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量子启发式双层优化框架，用于不确定环境下可再生能源集成的V2X能量管理，通过Q-EVO算法协调发电、EV调度、多类型能量交换及用户满意度，显著降低了负荷方差、成本和碳排放。
AI.research_question: 如何在不确定环境下有效协调可再生能源发电、电动汽车充放电调度、V2H/V2V/V2G多类型能量交换、运营风险及用户满意度，实现智能电网中可再生能源集成的V2X能量管理优化？
AI.motivation: 传统V2X能量管理方法难以同时处理多重能量交换模式、运营风险、用户满意度等多目标协同优化问题，且面临可再生能源和EV行为不确定性的挑战，现有优化算法收敛性和探索能力不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层优化理论、量子计算启发式优化算法（Q-EVO）、蒙特卡洛模拟、多目标优化
AI.method: 构建双层优化模型（上层最小化负荷方差、购电成本、碳排放和运营风险；下层最大化EV用户利润和满意度），开发量子启发式能量谷优化器（Q-EVO），采用蒙特卡洛采样建模不确定性。
AI.findings: 负荷方差降低30.69%（从12,559.59 kW²降至8,705.60 kW²），系统运营成本降低14.84%，碳排放减少11.18%，峰值净负荷降低19.96%；EV用户满意度在所有随机场景下保持0.99633以上；Q-EVO在优化性能和收敛行为上优于基准元启发式算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将量子计算启发机制引入能量谷优化器，提升了非线性随机优化问题的收敛稳定性和探索能力；构建了同时考虑运营风险与用户满意度的双层V2X能量管理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能电网运营商提供了可再生能源集成环境下V2X能量管理的可实施方案，实现了多目标协同优化，显著降低了成本、碳排放和负荷波动，同时保障了EV用户满意度。

title: Pricing Sustainability or Pricing Illiquidity? Evidence from ESG Index Futures
affiliations: University of Glasgow, Glasgow University, Inland Norway University of Applied Sciences and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

detail.title: Pricing Sustainability or Pricing Illiquidity? Evidence from ESG Index Futures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None of the authors has anything to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received.

detail.abstract: We investigate whether ESG index futures embed a distinct sustainability-related risk premium or whether pricing differences relative to conventional futures mainly reflect market frictions, especially lower relative liquidity. Using daily data on S&P 500 ESG and standard E-mini futures from 2020-2025 across front-, three-month, and six-month maturities, we construct ESG-conventional forward-premium differentials in unscaled, percentage, and log terms. We relate these differentials to relative open interest, relative spot-index valuation, macro-financial controls, liquidity-state interactions, term-structure specifications, and event-time policy shocks. The results show that the ESG-conventional spread is largely explained by relative liquidity and valuation effects rather than by a persistent sustainability premium. Greater ESG market depth compresses the premium gap, while macro-financial controls play a secondary and state-dependent role. Sensitivity increases with maturity and is strongest when liquidity is scarce, consistent with limits-to-arbitrage mechanisms and weaker arbitrage capacity in thinner ESG futures markets. Event-time regressions and local projections indicate that ESG-related policy shocks generate heterogeneous but short-lived adjustments and explain little medium-run variation once continuous liquidity and valuation channels are accounted for. Overall, ESG futures pricing appears to reflect market microstructure, participation constraints, and relative valuation dynamics rather than a separate sustainability factor. The findings suggest that as ESG derivatives mature and attract deeper participation, pricing alignment with conventional benchmarks should improve, reducing the scope for persistent ESG-conventional futures spreads.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2020-2025年S&P 500 ESG与标准E-mini期货的日度数据，发现ESG-传统期货价差主要由相对流动性和估值效应解释，而非可持续性风险溢价，且这一价差在流动性稀缺时更为显著。
AI.research_question: ESG指数期货是否包含独特的可持续性相关风险溢价，还是其与传统期货的定价差异主要反映市场摩擦（尤其是流动性差异）？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资的快速发展，ESG衍生品市场是否蕴含独立的可持续性风险溢价是一个重要但尚未充分解答的问题。区分真正的风险溢价与市场摩擦对资产定价、投资策略和监管政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续性风险溢价理论、市场微观结构理论、套利限制理论（limits-to-arbitrage）
AI.method: 使用2020-2025年S&P 500 ESG和标准E-mini期货的日度数据，构建未缩放、百分比和对数形式的ESG-传统远期溢价差。采用多维度回归分析，包括相对未平仓合约、相对现货指数估值、宏观金融控制变量、流动性状态交互项、期限结构设定以及事件时间政策冲击分析，并结合局部投影法（local projections）进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）ESG-传统价差主要由相对流动性和估值效应解释，而非可持续性溢价；（2）更大的ESG市场深度压缩溢价差；（3）宏观金融控制变量仅起次要且状态依赖的作用；（4）价差对流动性的敏感性随期限延长而增强，且在流动性稀缺时最强；（5）ESG相关政策冲击仅产生异质性且短暂的调整，在控制流动性渠道后对中长期变动解释力有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了ESG衍生品存在独立可持续性风险溢价的观点，证实定价差异主要源于市场微观结构和套利限制，为套利限制理论在ESG衍生品市场提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ESG衍生品投资者和监管者提供定价机制洞见：随着ESG期货市场成熟和参与者增多，定价将趋同于传统基准，减少套利机会；政策冲击的影响需结合流动性条件综合评估。

title: AIM (Adaptive, Inclusive, Moral) Political Economy: Introduction and Applications
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: AIM (Adaptive, Inclusive, Moral) Political Economy: Introduction and Applications
detail.abstract: The polycrisis marks a moment of global disruption, but it also opens a rare opportunity for intellectual transformation – what Yuen Yuen Ang calls polytunity. This essay introduces AIM (Adaptive, Inclusive, Moral) Political Economy as a paradigm designed for a disrupted, multipolar world. AIM replaces the industrial-colonial worldview that has long shaped political economy, challenging its mechanical assumptions, Eurocentric benchmarks, and claims of neutrality. AIM did not emerge recently; its core ideas and applications were already present in Ang’s earlier books, How China Escaped the Poverty Trap (2016) and China’s Gilded Age (2020), but misclassified due to structural erasure that confine non-Western scholarship to the realm of “exceptional cases.” Drawing on How China Escaped the Poverty Trap, Ang demonstrates AIM in action: development as a coevolutionary process in complex economic systems, and meta-institutions as higher-order designs that enable state-market coevolution. The essay concludes by situating AIM as a generative research paradigm – one whose roots lie in past work and whose canopy extends across ongoing projects in comparative corruption, fiscal capacity, and policy communication. AIM not only offers a compass for the current age of disruption, it extends an invitation to collectively build a more adaptive, pluralistic, and reflexive political economy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIM（适应性、包容性、道德）政治经济学范式，以应对当前全球多重危机带来的知识转型机遇。该范式挑战工业-殖民世界观，强调发展是复杂经济系统中的共同演化过程，元制度是促进国家-市场共同演化的高阶设计。AIM根植于作者早期关于中国的著作，但因结构性抹除被误归类为"例外案例"。文章将AIM定位为生成性研究范式，为多极化、 disrupted世界提供指引。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种适应多极、 disrupted世界的政治经济学新范式，以替代工业-殖民世界观主导的传统政治经济学？
AI.motivation: 全球多重危机（polycrisis）带来了知识转型的罕见机遇，而现有政治经济学框架仍受工业-殖民世界观支配，存在机械论假设、欧洲中心基准和虚假中立性等问题，无法有效解释和应对当前世界的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIM政治经济学范式；复杂经济系统中的共同演化理论；元制度（meta-institutions）理论；发展作为共同演化过程。
AI.method: 理论建构与范式提出，基于作者早期关于中国的实证研究（《中国如何摆脱贫困陷阱》《中国的镀金时代》）进行理论提炼和重新分类。
AI.findings: AIM范式包含三个核心维度：适应性（Adaptive）、包容性（Inclusive）、道德（Moral）；发展是复杂经济系统中的共同演化过程；元制度作为高阶设计能够促进国家与市场的良性共同演化；非西方学术被结构性抹除为"例外案例"而非被视为普遍理论的来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AIM政治经济学作为替代性研究范式，挑战工业-殖民世界观；揭示学术界的结构性抹除机制；将非西方经验从"例外"重新定位为理论建构的资源；为多极世界提供适应性、多元化和反思性的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对多重危机时代提供实践指南；拓展到比较腐败、财政能力和政策沟通等具体研究领域；邀请学界共同构建更具适应性和包容性的政治经济学。

title: Before the Allocation: An NGX Market Structure Framework for the Dangote Refinery Pan-African Listing

detail.title: Before the Allocation: An NGX Market Structure Framework for the Dangote Refinery Pan-African Listing
detail.abstract: The planned listing of Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE on the NigerianExchange (NGX) main board represents the largest capital market event in the exchange's history. With a free float of up to 10% of a refinery valued at approximately 50 billion, the implied offering of roughly 5 billion will test the absorptive capacity of the Nigerian equity market in ways that have no precedent at this scale. This note is not a valuation analysis. It is the pre-listing market structure framework that international allocators require to quantify NGX-specific risks before committing capital. We address three empirical questions in causal sequence: what price gap investors should expect between the Lagos listing and international entry points; whether the asset's USD- denominated dividend genuinely hedges an international investor against naira risk; and whether NGX has sufficient liquidity depth to absorb a free float of this magnitude within a reasonable investment horizon. Drawing on 2,916 common trading days of Seplat Energy's dual NGX–LSE listing as an empirical prior, a proxy revenue model anchored on publicly available refinery margin data, and weekly NGX turnover observations, we quantify each risk dimension with full methodological transparency. Our central findings are: an expected NGX discount of approximately 13.2% to international pricing, within a projected band of −7.1%to −21.1%; a base-case USD dividend yield of 0.23% at normalised crack spreads that falls to zero under current depressed margin conditions; and a free-float absorption horizon of 57 to 143 weeks at observed participation rates. Allocation decisions made without this framework underwrite unquantified structural risk.

AI.tldr: 本文为Dangote炼油厂在尼日利亚交易所（NGX）上市前的市场结构分析框架，不进行估值分析，而是重点量化国际投资者面临的三大结构性风险：NGX相对于国际定价的折扣、美元计价股息对奈拉风险的避险效果、以及NGX市场对大规模自由流通股的吸收能力。
AI.research_question: 国际投资者在Dangote炼油厂于尼日利亚交易所上市时，应预期面临哪些结构性风险？具体包括三个实证问题：（1）拉各斯上市价格与国际入场点之间的价差；（2）以美元计价的股息能否真正对冲奈拉风险；（3）NGX是否具备足够的流动性深度来吸收如此大规模的自由流通股。
AI.motivation: Dangote炼油厂计划在NGX主板上市，估值约500亿美元，自由流通股比例最高达10%（约50亿美元），这将是尼日利亚交易所历史上规模最大的资本市场事件。如此大规模的发售将以前所未有的方式考验尼日利亚股票市场的吸收能力，国际资本配置者需要量化NGX特有的风险才能做出投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Seplat Energy在NGX和LSE双重上市2,916个交易日的经验数据为先验参照，建立基于公开炼油厂利润率数据的代理收入模型，并结合每周NGX成交额观测数据，对每个风险维度进行量化分析。
AI.method: 采用因果序列的实证分析方法，利用Seplat Energy双重上市数据作为经验先验，构建代理收入模型，并使用NGX周度成交额观测数据。方法完全透明公开。
AI.findings: （1）预期NGX较国际定价存在约13.2%的折价，区间为-7.1%至-21.1%；（2）基准情境下美元股息收益率仅为0.23%，在当前利润率低迷条件下降至零；（3）在现有参与率下，自由流通股的吸收周期为57至143周。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为新兴市场大规模上市前的风险评估提供了一个结构化的分析框架，将双重上市价差、货币风险对冲有效性、市场流动性吸收能力三个维度纳入统一的因果序列分析体系，具有方法论的创新性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际机构投资者提供了量化尼日利亚交易所特有风险的决策工具，明确指出缺乏此框架的配置决策将承担未量化的结构性风险。帮助投资者在面临尼日利亚交易所史上最大规模上市事件时做出更理性的投资决策。

title: Behavioral Transmission of Aggression Across Early and Middle Childhood Public Environments: Dominance Hierarchy, Systemic Permissiveness, Institutional Non-Response, and Learned Regulatory Suppression in Socioeconomically Stressed Urban Environments
affiliations: Independent Researcher in Behavioral Science and Systems Psychology

detail.title: Behavioral Transmission of Aggression Across Early and Middle Childhood Public Environments: Dominance Hierarchy, Systemic Permissiveness, Institutional Non-Response, and Learned Regulatory Suppression in Socioeconomically Stressed Urban Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or personal, that could have influenced the conduct or interpretation of this study. The research was conducted independently, without institutional affiliation, and received no external funding. All observational data were collected by the author in her professional capacity as a qualified psychological diagnostician. The author has no financial relationship with any organization mentioned in this study, including the institutional bodies whose responses are documented.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study employed naturalistic observational methodology in public outdoor spaces and did not involve experimental procedures, clinical intervention, or direct recruitment of human participants. All observations were conducted in freely accessible public environments (playgrounds, pedestrian areas, and shared urban spaces) where behavior is visible to any member of the public. No personally identifiable information was collected, recorded, or stored. All individuals and cases referenced in the institutional documentation sections of this paper are described in anonymized or aggregate form. The institutional case materials cited were obtained through formal administrative proceedings in which the author was a party and are referenced solely in their aggregate and anonymized dimension. In accordance with the ethical standards applicable to naturalistic public observation research, formal ethics committee approval was not required. The research was conducted in full accordance with the ethical principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and the professional standards of psychological practice applicable in the jurisdiction of conduct.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All costs associated with the study were borne by the author independently. No grants, institutional support, or commercial sponsorship were received at any stage of the research or manuscript preparation.

detail.abstract: This paper presents findings from a structured naturalistic observational study conducted in urban public environments in Lodz, Poland, between 2020 and 2026. Drawing on more than 2,000 recorded behavioral episodes involving children aged 1.5 to 13 years, their caregivers, and adults in shared public space, the study examines the conditions under which aggressive and boundary-violating behavior is transmitted, reinforced, and institutionally tolerated across all levels of the social system-from child to caregiver to educational institution to supervisory authority to national ombudsman. The central structural finding is that a dominance hierarchy, rather than a normative rule system, functions as the operative organizing principle of social interaction at every level of the observed system. Those with greater behavioral aggression or institutional authority displace those with less, through bodily pressure, volume, or evaluative power-not through agreed rules. Approximately 30 percent of observed adults and children violate boundaries without apparent awareness that such boundaries exist; a further comparable proportion restrains itself only under perceived surveillance. The study introduces the Boundary Regulation Index (BRI) as an observational measure capturing four dimensions of boundary functioning in public peer environments. A secondary finding is the acquired behavioral camouflage pattern among developmentally advanced children-a learned regulatory suppression strategy distinct from clinical developmental presentations and carrying specific diagnostic implications. Two structurally distinct but developmentally convergent socialization patterns are identified: permissive-aggressive and victim-oriented suppressive, both producing environments in which boundary-maintenance capacity fails to develop. The study documents systematic non-response and active legitimacy-based suppression by institutional actors across the full institutional chain, including the Commissioner for Children's Rights. The findings are corroborated by national statistical data and aligned with the developmental time-lag hypothesis: the population-level outcomes currently documented in Polish adolescents are temporally consistent with the regulatory suppression of the cohort that was 2 to 9 years old during the study period. The paper is situated within evolutionary neuroscience, developmental psychology, institutional theory, and behavioral economics, and is analyzed through the Psychoeconomic Resilience Model (PRM).

AI.tldr: 本研究报告了2020-2026年在波兰罗兹市公共环境中对儿童、看护者及成人的自然观察研究（超2000个行为片段），发现社会系统的各个层面（从儿童到国家监察专员）均以支配等级而非规范规则作为实际组织原则；约30%的成年人和儿童在无意识状态下侵犯边界；研究引入边界调节指数（BRI）并识别出两种社会化模式：放任-攻击型和受害者导向压制型，均导致边界维护能力缺失；研究还发现发育超前儿童存在获得性行为伪装模式，并记录了从教育机构到国家监察专员的系统性不作为。
AI.research_question: 在公共环境中，攻击性和边界侵犯行为如何在从儿童到国家监察专员的整个社会系统各层面中被传递、强化和制度性容忍？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么在社会各层面中规范规则系统未能成为实际运作的组织原则，以及边界侵犯行为的系统性和体制性容忍机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化神经科学、发展心理学、制度理论、行为经济学，以及心理经济韧性模型（PRM）。
AI.method: 结构化自然观察法，在波兰罗兹市城市公共环境中收集了2020-2026年间超过2000个行为片段，研究对象为1.5岁至13岁儿童及其看护者和公共空间中的成人。
AI.findings: 1）支配等级而非规范规则是社会各层面的实际运作组织原则；2）约30%的成人及儿童在无意识中侵犯他人边界，另有约30%仅在感知到监视时才会自我约束；3）引入边界调节指数（BRI）用于测量公共环境中边界功能的四个维度；4）发育超前儿童存在获得性行为伪装模式；5）识别出两种结构性不同但发展性趋同的社会化模式：放任-攻击型和受害者导向压制型；6）从教育机构到国家儿童权利监察专员存在系统性的不作为和基于合法性的压制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了边界调节指数（BRI）作为新的观察测量工具；识别了"获得性行为伪装模式"这一区别于临床发展障碍的习得性调节抑制策略；提出了支配等级替代规范规则作为社会实际组织原则的结构性发现；将发展性时间滞后假说与人口层面数据相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为儿童保护机构、教育政策制定者和监督部门提供实证依据，揭示从基层到国家层面的系统性制度失灵；帮助临床工作者区分发展性儿童的伪装行为与临床发展障碍；为波兰及其他类似社会背景下的儿童权利保护改革提供数据支持。

title: Navigating Adversity: A Systematic Review of Rural Livelihood Challenges in Somaliland

detail.title: Navigating Adversity: A Systematic Review of Rural Livelihood Challenges in Somaliland
detail.abstract: This systematic review aimed to synthesize the extant literature on the multifaceted challenges confronting rural livelihoods in Somaliland. Following the PRISMA guidelines, a comprehensive search of academic databases and grey literature sources was conducted, identifying relevant studies published between 1991 and 2023. The review identified and analyzed four deeply interconnected thematic challenges: (1) Environmental and Climatic Shocks, including intensifying droughts, water scarcity, and pest outbreaks; (2) Economic and Livelihood Constraints, characterized by an over-reliance on pastoralism, limited diversification, and financial exclusion; (3) Political and Institutional Fragilities, rooted in non-recognition and limited state capacity; and (4) Social and Infrastructural Deficits, manifesting as crippling deficits in healthcare, education, and roads. The synthesis revealed that these themes form a vicious, self-reinforcing cycle of vulnerability, whereby a shock in one domain exacerbates pressures in another, trapping communities in a state of protracted crisis. The study concluded that the complex and synergistic nature of these adversities necessitates a fundamental shift away from siloed, short-term interventions towards integrated, multi-sectoral resilience-building approaches that are mindful of Somaliland's unique socio-political context. The review also highlighted significant gaps in the literature, pointing to avenues for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了索马里兰农村生计面临的四类相互关联的挑战（环境气候冲击、经济生计约束、政治制度脆弱、社会基础设施赤字），发现这些挑战形成恶性循环，呼吁采取整合性、多部门的韧性建设方案。
AI.research_question: 索马里兰农村生计面临哪些多维挑战？这些挑战之间如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 索马里兰农村社区长期处于危机状态，但现有文献对挑战的复杂性及其相互关联性的系统认识不足，需要整合性研究来指导政策干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性综述方法论（PRISMA指南）；脆弱性与韧性理论；恶性循环/自我强化机制理论。
AI.method: 按照PRISMA指南，对1991-2023年间学术数据库和灰色文献进行系统检索与综合分析。
AI.findings: 识别出四类核心挑战：环境气候冲击（干旱、水资源短缺、虫害）、经济生计约束（过度依赖畜牧业、缺乏多样化、金融排斥）、政治制度脆弱（未被国际承认、国家能力有限）、社会基础设施赤字（医疗、教育、道路严重不足）。四类挑战形成自我强化的恶性循环，导致社区陷入长期危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了索马里兰农村困境的多维性及其协同效应，提出了"恶性循环"的分析框架，为脆弱性理论提供了具体案例支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁从孤立、短期干预转向整合性、多部门的韧性建设方案；指出需充分考虑索马里兰独特的社会政治背景；为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Recognizing the Exceptional, Ignoring the Everyday: a Qualitative Study of Work Recognition Among Paramedics
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Recognizing the Exceptional, Ignoring the Everyday: a Qualitative Study of Work Recognition Among Paramedics
detail.abstract: The paramedic profession is undergoing a significant transformation driven by sociodemographic changes and evolving healthcare needs. As the profession shifts away from its historically transport-focused role toward more complex clinical, psychosocial and non-urgent transport, little is known about how organizations recognize these tasks. This study examines how paramedics perceive work recognition that manifests in their daily professional activities. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with twenty-one paramedics from five prehospital organizations in Quebec, Canada. Data were analyzed using an abductive thematic approach to capture both concept-driven and emergent dimensions of recognition. Findings show that recognition is largely absent from daily interactions and centers almost exclusively on rare, life-saving events. This outcome-based focus reinforces the gap between Work-as-Imagined and Work-as-Done, leaving everyday clinical and psychosocial work invisible. Furthermore, the public celebration of heroic acts may inadvertently exacerbate their emotional burden by requiring paramedics to revisit traumatic events. These results highlight the need for recognition practices that better reflect the realities of paramedic work and acknowledge the full range of contributions that shape everyday practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对21名魁北克救护人员的半结构化访谈，发现急救行业的认可机制几乎完全集中在罕见的"救命"事件上，忽视了日常临床和社会心理工作，导致"想象的工作"与"实际的工作"之间存在差距，且公开表彰英雄行为可能加重救护人员的情感负担。
AI.research_question: 急救人员如何在日常职业活动中感知到工作认可？这些认可是以何种形式呈现的？
AI.motivation: 随着急救行业从传统的运输导向角色向更复杂的临床、社会心理和非紧急运输转型，组织如何认可这些多元化工作任务尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: Work-as-Imagined与Work-as-Done的差距理论；基于结果的认可 vs. 基于过程的认可。
AI.method: 对加拿大魁北克省五个院前急救组织的21名急救人员进行半结构化访谈，采用溯因主题分析法（abductive thematic approach）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: （1）认可在日常互动中基本缺失，几乎完全集中在罕见的救命事件上；（2）这种基于结果的认可强化了"想象的工作"与"实际的工作"之间的差距；（3）公开庆祝英雄行为可能因要求急救人员重新经历创伤事件而加剧其情感负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Work-as-Imagined与Work-as-Done理论引入急救服务领域，揭示了基于结果的认可机制如何系统性忽视日常临床和社会心理工作，并指出英雄化叙事可能产生的负面情感后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为急救组织提供了改进认可实践的建议，强调需要建立更能反映急救工作现实、承认日常实践多元贡献的认可机制。

title:
The Human Layer Economics
Capital Incentives, Organizational Automation Bias, and the Structural Case for Governance Investment

detail.title:
The Human Layer Economics
Capital Incentives, Organizational Automation Bias, and the Structural Case for Governance Investment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Co-Founder and CEO of AtivoLabs, which builds AI-native infrastructure in tokenized finance, workforce productivity, and real estate operations. The frameworks described in this paper are relevant to systems the author has designed and deployed professionally. No external funding was received. No other competing interests exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a conceptual governance framework and institutional analysis. It does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical interventions, or personally identifiable information. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author in their capacity as a practitioner-researcher. All work was self-funded.

detail.abstract: The first three papers in this series established why the Human Layer matters, how to build it, and how to measure it. This paper addresses the question those papers raise but do not answer: if the evidence for augmentation over automation is this consistent, why does capital continue to flow toward replacement? The answer is not that executives are irrational. It is that the current incentive architecture makes removing the human layer structurally rational at the individual and organizational level, while externalizing the costs to a later period, a different line item, and often a different team. This paper identifies three capital incentive structures driving organizations toward automation: venture capital pricing dynamics, AI vendor pricing model evolution, and executive performance measurement. It introduces the concept of organizational automation bias: the systematic institutional tendency to overweight visible, near-term automation benefits and underweight deferred oversight costs. It then documents the three forces now collapsing the temporal gap that makes this externalization possible: regulatory enforcement becoming actualized, insurance and liability pricing beginning to incorporate AI risk, and institutional market access emerging as a gating function rather than a compliance aspiration. The paper closes with an empirically grounded argument, drawn from the SOX, GDPR, and ISO 27001 precedents, that the Human Layer Score introduced in Paper 3 is positioned to function as a capital markets signal for organizations operating in regulated, trust-dependent environments, and that governance infrastructure of this kind has historically been acquired most advantageously in the window before enforcement concentrates the market toward already-compliant actors.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了企业持续投资自动化替代人力，并非因为高管非理性，而是当前激励结构使得"去人力化"在个体和组织层面具有结构合理性，成本被外化到未来、其他部门或其他团队。论文识别了三种资本激励结构，提出"组织自动化偏见"概念，并论证了三种正在瓦解时间差的力量，最后指出Human Layer Score有望成为资本市场的信号工具。
AI.research_question: 既然增强（人机协作）而非替代（自动化）的证据如此一致，为什么资本仍然持续流向替代性方案？
AI.motivation: 前两篇论文已经论证了"人类层"为何重要、如何构建及如何衡量，但未回答资本为何持续流向替代方案这一核心矛盾。本文旨在揭示这一悖论背后的结构性原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织自动化偏见（Organizational Automation Bias）：系统性的制度倾向，即高估可见的、近期的自动化收益，低估延迟的监督成本。以及资本激励结构理论。
AI.method: 理论分析与案例论证相结合，基于SOX、GDPR和ISO 27001等监管先例进行经验性推演。
AI.findings: 1）三种资本激励结构（风投定价、AI供应商定价模式、高管绩效衡量）驱动组织走向自动化；2）三种力量正在瓦解成本外化的时间差：监管执法的实质化、保险与责任定价开始纳入AI风险、机构市场准入成为门槛而非合规愿景；3）Human Layer Score有望在监管趋严前成为资本市场的信号工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"组织自动化偏见"这一新概念，系统解释了企业在自动化决策中的系统性非理性行为背后的结构理性基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了在监管集中化之前建立治理基础设施的战略窗口判断框架，并为人力资源、合规及投资决策提供了可操作的分析工具（Human Layer Score）。

title:
Preventive Healthcare as Fiscal Infrastructure: 
Public Nutrition Hubs and the Political Economy of U.S. Chronic Disease Costs
affiliations: Independent Policy Researcher

detail.title:
Preventive Healthcare as Fiscal Infrastructure: 
Public Nutrition Hubs and the Political Economy of U.S. Chronic Disease Costs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects research, clinical intervention, or identifiable individual-level data. Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
U.S. healthcare reform debates concentrate on insurance coverage, drug prices, hospital billing,
and administrative costs. These remain central. Yet the existing federal nutrition policy
architecture — WIC, SNAP-Ed, the Healthy Food Financing Initiative, Farm to School, and
federal school meal standards — leaves a specific institutional layer unfilled: there is no general-
population public prepared-meal infrastructure that could function as community-facing
preventive capacity. This paper argues that this institutional vacuum is a relevant policy variable
for U.S. chronic disease cost trajectories, and proposes one design — Public Nutrition Hub
Networks — for testing what filling it might do.
The contribution of this paper is not the claim that food affects health, which is well established,
nor that procurement has been absent from nutrition policy. The contribution is threefold and
narrower. First, it specifies a procurement-as-coalition mechanism that converts potential local-
restaurant opposition into structured supplier-network participation, drawing on public
procurement scholarship on procurement as a policy instrument (McCrudden, 2004; Mazzucato,
2018). Second, it formalizes adaptive nutrition standards as an implementation theory rather than
a compliance framework, addressing the documented plate-waste and uptake failures of stricter
school meal standards (Cohen et al., 2014; Bleich et al., 2018). Third, it specifies a school-adjacent
safety architecture as a precondition for community-facing public meal infrastructure in the U.S.
context, an issue largely absent from comparative public-meal scholarship that draws on systems
built before contemporary American school-security constraints.
The paper does not claim immediate healthcare savings or clinical efficacy independent of
evidence-based medicine. It proposes a long-horizon fiscal-prevention framework to be tested
through 3-5 year local pilots, with explicit treatment of identification threats, edge cases where
mitigation may fail, and documented negative lessons from comparator systems (Korea's 2011
free-meal political conflict; Japan's 2012 Chofu allergy fatality; Finnish school meal cost-quality
pressures). Its central argument is that one specific gap in the U.S. nutrition policy stack —
community-facing prepared-meal infrastructure — is testable, fiscally bounded, and politically
tractable if designed as a procurement coalition rather than as substitution for private food service.

AI.tldr: 本文指出美国现有联邦营养政策体系中缺少面向普通人群的公共预制餐基础设施，提出"公共营养中心网络"（Public Nutrition Hub Networks）设计，以填补这一制度空白，为慢性病成本控制提供可检验的财政预防框架。
AI.research_question: 美国现行联邦营养政策体系中的制度空白（缺乏面向普通人群的公共预制餐基础设施）是否是一个影响慢性病成本轨迹的相关政策变量？如何设计一个可检验的解决方案？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国医疗改革聚焦保险覆盖、药价、医院账单和管理成本，但现有营养政策架构（WIC、SNAP-Ed、健康食品融资倡议、农场到学校、联邦学校餐标准）仍缺少一个面向普通人群的社区预防性公共餐食基础设施，这一制度真空可能对慢性病成本轨迹产生重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 采购作为政策工具的公共采购理论（McCrudden, 2004; Mazzucato, 2018）；2) 适应性营养标准作为实施理论而非合规框架；3) 学校邻近安全架构作为社区公共餐食基础设施的前提条件。
AI.method: 概念性设计与理论论证，提出3-5年地方试点的长期财政预防框架，明确识别威胁的处理、边缘案例的缓解失败可能性，并借鉴韩国、日本、芬兰等比较系统的负面经验教训。
AI.findings: 1) 提出了"采购即联盟"机制，将潜在的地方餐饮业反对转化为结构化供应商网络参与；2) 将适应性营养标准形式化为实施理论而非合规框架，以解决学校餐标准中的餐盘浪费和接受度问题；3) 在美国语境下，学校邻近安全架构是社区公共餐食基础设施的先决条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将公共采购理论扩展到营养政策领域，提出"采购即联盟"机制；2) 重新概念化营养标准，从合规框架转向实施理论；3) 填补比较公共餐食研究中关于美国学校安全约束的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国慢性病财政预防提供了可检验、财政可行且政治上可操作的制度设计方案（公共营养中心网络），包括具体的试点周期（3-5年）、识别威胁处理机制以及从韩国、日本、芬兰等国吸取的负面教训。

title: PIDL: A Prompt Injection Detection Layer for LLM-Integrated Web Applications via Multi-Signal Semantic Analysis

detail.title: PIDL: A Prompt Injection Detection Layer for LLM-Integrated Web Applications via Multi-Signal Semantic Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research received no external funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a computer science systems design paper involving no human participants, patient data, or experimental studies requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded. No external grants or funding bodies supported this work.

detail.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) APIs are increasingly embedded into production web applications, creating a new class of security vulnerability: prompt injection. An adversarial user can embed instructions within their input that override the application's system prompt, exfiltrate confidential configuration, or redirect model behavior. No standardized, pre-execution defense mechanism currently exists for this threat class. We propose the Prompt Injection Detection Layer (PIDL), a stateless middleware component that intercepts user inputs before they are dispatched to an LLM API. PIDL executes a four-signal semantic analysis pipeline-detecting instruction-override patterns, semantic domain deviation, imperative density, and boundary marker presence-and computes a scalar Adversarial Intent Score (AIS) using a weighted linear combination. Inputs exceeding a configurable threshold are routed to a four-transformation sanitization stage before dispatch. PIDL is modelagnostic, requires no modification to the underlying LLM, and is designed to operate within a < 100ms latency budget for inputs up to 4,096 tokens. We describe the system architecture, signal formulations, scoring rationale, and sanitization transformations, and discuss deployment considerations. PIDL provides a principled, auditable foundation for prompt injection defense that complements existing alignment techniques.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PIDL的轻量级中间件，用于在LLM API调用前检测并防御提示注入攻击，通过四信号语义分析生成对抗意图分数（AIS），并对高风险输入进行消毒处理。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种标准化、预执行的防御机制，在用户输入到达LLM API之前检测并阻止提示注入攻击？
AI.motivation: LLM API越来越多地嵌入生产级Web应用，但提示注入作为一种新型安全漏洞尚无标准化的预执行防御机制，攻击者可注入指令覆盖系统提示、窃取配置或改变模型行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四信号语义分析框架：指令覆盖模式检测、语义域偏离、指令密度、边界标记存在性；加权线性组合计算对抗意图分数（AIS）。
AI.method: 设计PIDL无状态中间件，包含四信号语义分析管道和四变换消毒阶段；使用加权线性组合计算AIS分数；超过可配置阈值则路由至消毒阶段。
AI.findings: PIDL是模型无关的，无需修改底层LLM，可在4096 token输入下维持<100ms延迟预算，为提示注入防御提供了可审计的标准化基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个系统化的预执行提示注入检测框架，建立了四信号语义分析的理论基础，并设计了可解释的对抗意图评分机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接部署的轻量级中间件方案，模型无关、低延迟，可补充现有对齐技术，为生产环境LLM应用提供了可落地的安全防护层。

title:
The Ontological Reduction of the Village Republic: 
Statutory Capture, Constitutional Inversion, and the Future of Article 371A

detail.title:
The Ontological Reduction of the Village Republic: 
Statutory Capture, Constitutional Inversion, and the Future of Article 371A
detail.abstract: This paper forms part of an ongoing series examining the constitutional, statutory, and institutional foundations of governance in Nagaland. It is offered as a contribution to critical public reasoning, an invitation to interrogate the legal architectures that shape our collective life and to consider how they may be strengthened to protect both community autonomy and democratic accountability. The analysis that follows emerges from a recent and rigorous public discourse on the relationship between Article 371A and the Nagaland Village Councils (NVC) Act of 1978. It is presented as a critical position paper intended to facilitate intellectual dialogue, systemic reflection, and informed public engagement. The arguments are grounded in a close reading of primary statutory texts and the constitutional framework of Article 371A of the Constitution of India. This work should not be read as a critique of any individual or institution, but as a structural inquiry into the frameworks within which they operate. Its purpose is not to undermine administrative practice, but to illuminate the gaps between constitutional promise and statutory reality, and to encourage thoughtful dialogue on how those gaps may be bridged. It is an independent intellectual exercise undertaken to safeguard the integrity of our ancestral institutions, ensuring they are preserved not merely in name or form, but protected in function and essence. This inquiry focuses specifically on the institutional and sovereign identity of the Village Republic. For a detailed examination of the broader legislative failures concerning resource management, dead capital, and fiscal agency under Section 12 of the Act, readers are referred to the author's companion policy paper, From Veto to Guarantee: Why Nagaland Must Author Its Own Rights. Readers are encouraged to engage with this work as a platform for discussion, critique, and collaborative thinking toward a more coherent, community-anchored governance architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文以印度宪法第371A条与1978年那加兰邦村务委员会法案为焦点，系统审视那加兰邦治理的宪法、法律与制度基础，揭示宪法承诺与法定现实之间的鸿沟，旨在保护"乡村共和国"的制度与主权完整性。
AI.research_question: 印度宪法第371A条与1978年那加兰邦村务委员会法案之间的法律关系如何？现行法律架构在保护社区自治与民主问责方面存在哪些结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 那加兰邦围绕第371A条与村务委员会法案之间关系存在激烈的公共讨论，作者旨在通过结构性分析促进理性对话，而非攻击任何个人或机构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法解释理论、制度分析理论、社区自治与民主问责理论、法律现实主义
AI.method: 对印度宪法第371A条及1978年那加兰邦村务委员会法案等一级法定文本进行细读与文本分析，辅以批判性公共推理。
AI.findings: 宪法承诺与法定现实之间存在显著鸿沟；村务委员会作为"乡村共和国"的制度与主权身份受到侵蚀；现行架构在社区自治与民主问责之间未能实现良序平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宪法解释理论与制度分析相结合，提出结构性审查框架，用于评估联邦制下特殊条款与地方法律之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为那加兰邦治理改革提供分析基础；指出需要修正法律以保护村务委员会的功能与本质而非仅保留名义；引导公众就社区自治与民主问责的平衡展开理性讨论。

title: AML Observability: Rethinking Transaction Monitoring as a Debuggable Compliance System An Architectural Position Paper with a Larger Synthetic Evaluation
affiliations: Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: AML Observability: Rethinking Transaction Monitoring as a Debuggable Compliance System An Architectural Position Paper with a Larger Synthetic Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The paper does not involve human participants, patients, or personal data; the evaluation uses synthetic transactions only.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
AML transaction monitoring systems are widely deployed across financial institutions, yet they often remain difficult to reconstruct, explain, and evaluate in production. This paper argues that a key limitation is not only insufficient detection logic, but insufficient system observability. It defines AML Observability as the capability to reconstruct detection-relevant decisions across the full processing lifecycle and reframes recurring AML control breakdowns as diagnosability gaps rather than isolated detection misses.

The paper makes five linked contributions. First, it proposes a five-layer AML observability architecture and the Transformation Spiral as a sequencing model linking data governance, system observability, AI observability, and AI enablement. Second, it interprets public enforcement cases through an OBASHI-informed lens and derives a compact anti-pattern library, including Upstream Blindspot, Silent Transformation Drop, Threshold Suppression, and Broken Feedback Loop. Third, it formalizes a minimal event-centric proof of concept in Python built around an AMLTrace/AMLTraceEvent model, explicit query semantics for why_flagged, why_not_flagged, and what_changed, and privacy-aware trace retention. Fourth, it extends the same trace schema toward AI governance by embedding model-specific artifacts such as feature attribution, confidence distributions, and drift indicators into the compliance trace. Fifth, it adds a production-oriented architecture sketch and a larger synthetic comparison between a monitoring-only baseline and an observable system.

The larger evaluation processes 1,000 synthetic transactions, including 300 injected faults distributed across six fault families spanning the five-layer stack. Across the fault cases, the observable system improves mean diagnosis completeness from 0.25 to 1.00, failure-layer attribution accuracy from 0.17 to 1.00, and reduces explanation steps from 4.0 to 1.0 relative to the baseline.
