detail.abstract: Short-term electric load forecasting (STLF) is essential for efficient power system operation, yet existing deep learning models often struggle to simultaneously capture high-frequency transient fluctuations and complex inter-variable dependencies in multivariate load data, leading to over-smoothing and structural distortion. To address these challenges, we propose a Hybrid Graph-enhanced Time-Frequency Network (HGTFNet) that jointly improves numerical accuracy and morphological and spectral fidelity, where fidelity is assessed by waveform morphology (DTW) and harmonic energy distribution (nSpecMAE). HGTFNet adopts a dual-path spectral–temporal architecture that integrates an inverted Transformer backbone with an explicit frequency-domain branch, enabling decoupling of periodic components and stochastic fluctuations while mitigating high-frequency attenuation. A dynamic graph learning module further models cross-variable dependencies to enforce synchronized evolution across multiple load series. In addition, an adaptive temporal query mechanism and a multi-scale convolution module align non-stationary periodic phases and capture fine-grained local variations. Experiments on a real-world urban load dataset (three supply zones) show that HGTFNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple horizons, achieving up to a 21.2% reduction in MAPE compared to iTransformer. Beyond point-wise accuracy, HGTFNet improves fidelity, with up to a 13.7% reduction in DTW and lower nSpecMAE, supported by frequency-domain visualizations. Sensitivity analysis further indicates that performance gains arise from adaptive synergy between temporal and frequency representations rather than any single module. Overall, by effectively alleviating over-smoothing and preserving transient peak dynamics, HGTFNet provides a structurally consistent and robust forecasting solution, offering reliable support for secure grid operation and efficient energy management under complex load conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出混合图增强时频网络（HGTFNet），通过双路谱-时架构、动态图学习和自适应时序查询等模块，同时提升短期电力负荷预测的数值精度与形态、频谱保真度，在真实数据集上较iTransformer降低MAPE最高达21.2%。
AI.research_question: 如何同时提高短期电力负荷预测的数值准确性以及波形形态（DTW）和频谱能量分布（nSpecMAE）的保真度？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型难以同时捕捉多变量负荷数据中的高频瞬态波动和复杂变量间依赖关系，导致预测结果过度平滑和结构失真。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双路谱-时架构（倒置Transformer主干+显式频域分支）、动态图学习、自适应时序查询机制、多尺度卷积模块。
AI.method: HGTFNet混合网络：①双路谱-时架构解耦周期成分与随机波动；②动态图学习模块建模跨变量依赖；③自适应时序查询对齐非平稳周期相位；④多尺度卷积捕获细粒度局部变化。
AI.findings: 在三个供电区域真实城市负荷数据集上，HGTFNet在多预测时域上一致优于SOTA基线：MAPE较iTransformer降低最高21.2%，DTW降低最高13.7%，nSpecMAE更低；性能提升源于时域与频域表征的自适应协同。
AI.theory_contributions: ①提出结合形态保真度（DTW）和频谱保真度（nSpecMAE）的双维评估框架；②揭示时域与频域表征协同机制对缓解过度平滑的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂负荷条件下电网安全运行和能源高效管理提供结构一致且稳健的预测解决方案，有效保留瞬态峰值动态。

title: Shannon--Neumann Least Action Principle: Normatively Constrained Epistemic-Utility Dynamics in Cognitive AI
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Shannon--Neumann Least Action Principle: Normatively Constrained Epistemic-Utility Dynamics in Cognitive AI
detail.abstract: We propose a variational framework for cognitive AI in which adaptive behavior emerges from minimizing a normatively constrained epistemic–utility action over trajectories. The resulting Shannon–Neumann Least Action Principle (SN-LAP) unifies three core components of intelligent systems: information acquisition (epistemic learning), goal-directed optimization (utility), and constraint satisfaction (normative alignment). We derive both discrete- and continuous-time formulations, showing that SN-LAP induces tractable update rules closely related to entropy-regularized and multi-objective reinforcement learning. The continuous limit yields Euler--Lagrange equations governing cognitive dynamics, while regularization introduces second-order dynamics with momentum and dissipation. We establish existence of extremal trajectories and analyze stability via Lyapunov methods, demonstrating that dissipation induces convergence to norm-compliant equilibria. We further show that symmetries of the SN-action give rise to conserved quantities analogous to Noether charges, providing a principled interpretation of persistent exploratory behavior. A minimal tabular MDP experiment illustrates how normative terms systematically trade off performance and constraint satisfaction, recovering standard reinforcement learning as a special case.SN-LAP provides a unified, trajectory-level perspective linking variational inference, energy-based models, and reinforcement learning, offering a principled foundation for designing adaptive and normatively aligned AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出香农-诺伊曼最小作用量原理（SN-LAP），将信息获取、目标优化和规范约束统一在变分框架下，推导出离散与连续时间两种形式，并证明其可生成符合规范的适应性行为。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的理论框架，使认知AI系统能够在信息获取、目标优化和规范约束三者之间实现自适应行为的平衡？
AI.motivation: 现有认知AI方法（如强化学习、变分推理、能量模型）通常在信息获取、目标优化和规范约束三个维度上彼此割裂，缺乏统一的变分原理来刻画智能系统在轨迹层面上的自适应行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 香农-诺伊曼最小作用量原理（SN-LAP），结合了变分推理、能量模型和强化学习，利用最小作用量原理统一认知系统的信息论（香农熵）与优化论（诺伊曼效用）维度。
AI.method: 提出离散和连续时间两种形式的SN-LAP变分框架；在连续极限下推导出欧拉-拉格朗日方程；引入正则化项产生含动量和耗散的二阶动力学；利用李雅普诺夫方法分析稳定性；通过诺特定理识别守恒量；在表格MDP环境下进行最小实验验证。
AI.findings: (1) SN-LAP可推出与熵正则化和多目标强化学习相近的可处理更新规则；(2) 耗散可导致收敛到符合规范的均衡态；(3) 对称性对应诺特电荷，为持久探索行为提供原理性解释；(4) 规范项可在性能与约束满足之间进行系统性权衡；(5) 标准强化学习为该框架的一个特例。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SN-LAP这一统一变分原理，建立了认知AI中信息获取、目标优化和规范约束三个维度的理论桥梁；揭示了变分推理、能量模型和强化学习之间的深层联系；从第一性原理推导了智能系统轨迹层面的适应性行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计具备规范对齐能力的自适应AI系统提供了可操作的理论基础；SN-LAP的可推导更新规则可直接应用于多目标强化学习和熵正则化算法；对持久探索行为的守恒量解释有助于调试和解释AI系统的长期行为。

title: Upgrade or Evade: Heterogeneous Firm Responses to Foreign Environmental Regulations
affiliations: Xi’an Jiaotong University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Upgrade or Evade: Heterogeneous Firm Responses to Foreign Environmental Regulations
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how destination-market environmental regulation reshapes exporters’ environmental performance and strategic trade patterns. Exploiting the implementation of the EU’s WEEE and RoHS directives as a quasi-natural experiment, we employ a difference-in-differences design with continuous treatment intensity using comprehensive Chinese firm-level data. We find that while the directives reduce aggregate emission intensity, this average effect masks profound firm-level heterogeneity. High-productivity firms achieve emission reductions primarily by augmenting investment in end-of-pipe abatement and enhancing treatment efficiency. In contrast, low-productivity firms exhibit negligible abatement adjustments and instead reallocate exports toward less regulated destinations. We rationalize these patterns within a Melitz-style framework where destination-specific compliance costs induce a sorting mechanism: high-productivity firms internalize abatement costs to retain market access, while low-productivity firms exit the regulated market. Consequently, while destination-based regulation succeeds in cleaning up supply chains for developed markets, it inadvertently deepens the North-South environmental divide. The strategic diversion of dirty exports by laggard firms highlights a critical trade-off: unilateral standards drive upgrading at the top but trigger pollution leakage at the bottom, shifting the environmental burden to developing nations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧盟WEEE和RoHS指令作为准自然实验，研究目的地市场环境规制如何重塑出口企业的环境绩效和战略贸易模式。发现高生产率企业通过末端治理投资降低排放，而低生产率企业则将出口转向监管较宽松的目的地，导致污染泄露至发展中国家。
AI.research_question: 目的地市场的环境规制如何异质性影响不同生产率出口企业的环境绩效与战略贸易模式？
AI.motivation: 揭示单边环境规制在改善发达国家供应链环境绩效的同时，是否会导致污染通过低生产率企业的出口转移泄露至发展中国家，从而加剧南北环境鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Melitz异质性企业贸易理论，引入目的地特定合规成本，构建企业生产率异质性下的自选择机制：高生产率企业内化合规成本以维持市场准入，低生产率企业退出受监管市场并转移出口。
AI.method: 以欧盟WEEE和RoHS指令为准自然实验，采用连续处理强度的双重差分法（DID），使用中国工业企业层面综合数据。
AI.findings: （1）指令降低了总体排放强度，但掩盖了深刻的企业异质性；（2）高生产率企业通过增加末端治理投资和处理效率提升实现减排；（3）低生产率企业几乎没有减排调整，而是将出口重新分配到监管更宽松的目的地。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Melitz异质性企业贸易框架与目的地环境规制相结合，揭示了单边环境政策导致的企业异质性响应和全球污染泄露的微观机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者：单边环境标准虽然能推动头部企业绿色升级，但会引发尾部企业的污染泄露，将环境负担转嫁给发展中国家，需要全球协调的环境治理机制。

title: Dirty Chasing or Data Cheating? The Environmental Trade-offs of Meeting GDP Targets in China
affiliations: Hunan University, Hunan University and City University of Macau

detail.title: Dirty Chasing or Data Cheating? The Environmental Trade-offs of Meeting GDP Targets in China
detail.abstract: Does the high-powered incentive of GDP targeting come at an unintended environmental cost? Using Chinese prefecture-level panel data from 2003 to 2023, we construct a bunching-ITT framework to quantify the environmental externalities of target-based GDP manipulation. We document that manipulation to the GDP target completion threshold significantly elevates both the levels and intensities of regional SO2and CO2emissions. Mechanism tests establish that these environmental costs arise primarily from two forms of substantive dirty chasing: the strategic environmental deregulation and short-termism in resource allocation, rather than mere statistical cheating. Heterogeneity analysis explores the differential effects of institutional constraints and official characteristics on manipulation incentives and their environmental consequences. On the incentive side, cadre evaluation reforms and flexible target-setting significantly reduce the probability of manipulation. On the consequences side, the environmental externalities of GDP manipulation are less pronounced in cities led by officials in their promotion window or approaching retirement, as well as in regions subject to central environmental inspections. Our findings provide micro-level causal evidence on the agency costs and behavioral distortions embedded in China's target-based governance system.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2003-2023年中国地级市面板数据，通过bunching-ITT框架量化了GDP目标操纵的环境外部性，发现GDP达标阈值附近的操纵行为显著增加了区域SO₂和CO₂排放，其机制是战略性环境放松管制和资源配置短视主义，而非单纯的统计造假。
AI.research_question: GDP目标的高能激励是否带来了非预期的环境成本？
AI.motivation: 揭示中国目标治理体制中，基于GDP目标的操纵行为对环境产生的外部性，并提供微观层面的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标治理理论、委托代理理论、环境外部性理论、bunching估计方法
AI.method: 构建bunching-ITT（意向性处理效应）框架，使用2003-2023年中国地级市面板数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）GDP目标阈值附近的操纵显著提高了SO₂和CO₂排放水平与强度；（2）机制主要是实质性"脏追逐"（环境放松管制与资源分配短视），而非统计造假；（3）干部考核改革和灵活目标设定降低了操纵概率；（4）处于晋升窗口期或临近退休的官员所在城市，以及受中央环保督察的地区，环境外部性更弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 为目标治理体制中的代理成本和行为扭曲提供了微观因果证据，拓展了GDP目标操纵环境后果的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为完善干部考核制度、优化目标设定方式、加强中央环保督察等政策实践提供了经验支撑。

title: Can Automation Reshape Demographics? The Effect of Robots on Fertility Rates and Sex Ratio Imbalance in China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Peking University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Can Automation Reshape Demographics? The Effect of Robots on Fertility Rates and Sex Ratio Imbalance in China
detail.abstract: This study examines how automation shapes fertility transitions in China, focusing on within-marriage births and sex ratio at birth. Using a Bartik IV combined with first difference in nationally representative household panel data, we find that greater robot exposure reduces within-marriage fertility and lowers the likelihood of additional births when prior children are all girls. Effects are larger in regions with more traditional cultural norms and among younger, less-educated women. Mechanism evidence is consistent with a dominant substitution effect as women’s relative wages rise. Quantity–quality considerations appear less important for overall fertility but may affect the gender-composition margin.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用巴蒂克工具变量与一阶差分法，基于全国代表性家庭面板数据，发现机器人暴露减少婚内生育率，尤其是在传统性别偏好强烈的地区和年轻低学历女性群体中。替代效应（女性相对工资上升）是主要机制，而数量-质量权衡影响性别构成而非总体生育率。
AI.research_question: 自动化如何影响中国的生育转变，特别是婚内生育数量和出生性别比？
AI.motivation: 自动化正在全球范围内重塑劳动力市场，但对其如何影响家庭生育决策的研究尚不充分，尤其是在性别偏好显著的中国语境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代效应（女性相对工资上升降低生育意愿）与数量-质量权衡（自动化提高教育回报，促使家庭减少生育数量、增加子女质量投资）。
AI.method: 采用巴蒂克工具变量（Bartik IV）结合一阶差分法，分析全国代表性家庭面板数据。
AI.findings: 机器人暴露降低婚内生育率；在已有女孩的家庭中，机器人暴露进一步降低再生育可能性；效果在传统文化规范较强的地区和年轻、低学历女性中更显著；替代效应（女性相对工资上升）是主要机制；数量-质量权衡对总体生育率影响有限，但影响性别构成。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自动化冲击引入家庭生育决策分析框架，区分替代效应与数量-质量权衡在生育率与性别选择中的不同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解技术变迁对人口结构的影响提供实证证据，对应对自动化时代的生育率下降和性别比例失衡具有政策启示。

title: The migration law of platinum group metals and ultrasonic assisted leaching in the process of selective dissolution and iron enrichment of Fe-PGMs alloy
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Kunming University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The migration law of platinum group metals and ultrasonic assisted leaching in the process of selective dissolution and iron enrichment of Fe-PGMs alloy
detail.abstract: The concentration of Fe-PGMs, an intermediate product obtained through pyrometallurgical capture from waste automotive catalysts, is an important pathway for the efficient recycling and utilization of platinum group metals as secondary resources, which brings both economic and environmental benefits. In this study, the occurrence states of Pt, Pd, and Rh in Fe-PGMs alloy were characterized. The migration law of PGMs and the dissolution kinetics of Fe were analyzed by acid leaching experiments. Based on the results, an ultrasonic-assisted selective iron removal and platinum group metal enrichment process was proposed. The results reveal that with the increase of PGMs content, Pd precipitates as high-purity second-phase particles. Compared with hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid can significantly inhibit the dissolution of Pt and Pd. The introduction of ultrasound in sulfuric acid enhances the interfacial mass transfer efficiency, and ascorbic acid acts as a potential buffer to inhibit the dissolution of Rh induced by micro-galvanic corrosion. Under the optimum conditions, the concentration of Fe in the leaching solution increased from 39.05 g/L to 58.33 g/L, and the concentration of Rh decreased from 23.7 mg/L to 2.6 mg/L. After enrichment, the platinum group metal grade of Fe-PGMs alloy increased from 0.51% to 6.04% and 6.85% to 23.6%. Finally, 99% of Rh in the leaching solution was recovered by zinc powder displacement method. This study provides an efficient and industrial application prospect of PGMs concentration technology route.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种超声辅助选择性除铁和铂族金属（PGMs）富集工艺，通过酸浸和超声处理，成功将Fe-PGMs合金中的铂族金属品位从0.51%提升至23.6%，并实现了Rh的高效回收（99%）。
AI.research_question: 如何高效地从Fe-PGMs中间合金中选择性去除铁并富集铂族金属（Pt、Pd、Rh）？
AI.motivation: 废汽车催化剂中铂族金属作为二次资源具有重要的经济和环境价值，通过火法捕集得到的Fe-PGMs中间合金是回收PGMs的重要途径，但需要解决铁的选择性去除和PGMs的高效富集问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: PGMs在Fe-PGMs合金中的赋存状态理论；酸浸动力学；微电偶腐蚀理论；超声增强界面传质理论。
AI.method: 采用表征分析（赋存状态分析）和酸浸实验（对比盐酸与硫酸、引入超声、添加抗坏血酸）研究PGMs迁移规律和Fe溶解动力学，优化工艺参数，最后用锌粉置换法回收浸出液中的Rh。
AI.findings: （1）随PGMs含量增加，Pd以高纯度第二相颗粒析出；（2）硫酸相比盐酸能显著抑制Pt和Pd的溶解；（3）超声增强硫酸中界面传质效率；（4）抗坏血酸抑制Rh的微电偶腐蚀溶解；（5）最优条件下Fe浓度从39.05 g/L升至58.33 g/L，Rh浓度从23.7 mg/L降至2.6 mg/L；（6）PGMs品位从0.51%提升至6.04%和6.85%→23.6%；（7）锌粉置换回收99%的Rh。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同PGMs（Pt、Pd、Rh）在Fe-PGMs合金中的赋存状态及酸浸过程中的迁移规律；阐明了超声和抗坏血酸在选择性除铁过程中的作用机制（超声增强传质、抗坏血酸抑制微电偶腐蚀）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一条高效的超声辅助选择性除铁和PGMs富集工艺路线，可将PGMs品位大幅提升，并通过锌粉置换高效回收Rh，具有工业应用前景。

title: Out of sight, out of mind: Informal used vehicle trade as a blind spot in EV transition governance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of California, Davis

detail.title: Out of sight, out of mind: Informal used vehicle trade as a blind spot in EV transition governance
detail.abstract: International trade in second-hand vehicles (SHVs) plays an important but poorly documented role in shaping vehicle fleets and material flows. In North America, large numbers of vehicles are informally exported from the US to Mexico and remain absent from official trade statistics. This study quantifies these hidden flows using a novel modeling framework integrating field survey data, literature benchmarks, and administrative records within a US–Mexico vehicle stock turnover model. Results indicate that formal and informal SHV exports represent 12–15% of annual US vehicle retirements, while informal imports add an estimated 24–45% to vehicles entering the Mexican fleet. By 2050, nearly 30% of cumulative US end-of-life EV battery mass may exit the country embedded in SHV exports. These findings identify informal SHV trade as a blind spot in EV transition governance and point to upstream markets, particularly salvage vehicle auctions, as a strategic regulatory opportunity to improve transparency and battery circularity.

AI.tldr: 本研究量化了美国与墨西哥之间未被统计的二手车及废旧车辆跨境流动，发现这类非正规贸易占美国年度车辆报废量的12–15%，并为墨西哥车队贡献24–45%的增量。到2050年，美国近30%的退役电动车电池将随二手车出口流失，构成了电动汽车转型治理的盲点。
AI.research_question: 北美地区（美墨之间）非正规二手车出口的规模有多大？这对电动车电池材料流的治理意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 二手车国际贸易在塑造车队和物质流中作用重要但记录不足；大量车辆从美国非正规出口到墨西哥，未出现在官方贸易统计中，成为治理盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 车辆库存周转模型；物质流分析；非正规贸易与正规治理的缺口理论。
AI.method: 整合实地调查数据、文献基准和行政记录，构建美墨车辆库存周转模型的创新建模框架，量化正规与非正规二手车流动。
AI.findings: ①正规与非正规二手车出口占美国年报废量的12–15%；②非正规进口使墨西哥车队增加24–45%；③到2050年，美国近30%的退役电动车电池质量将随二手车出口流失到境外。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非正规二手车贸易作为电动汽车转型治理中一个被忽视的关键盲点，拓展了物质流分析与可持续交通治理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出上游市场（特别是报废车拍卖）作为战略性监管切入点，为提升二手车贸易透明度和电池循环利用提供政策建议。

title: Irrigation Transformation in India: Assessing the Impact of PMKSY Using Counterfactual Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Institute for Social and Economic Change (ISEC)

detail.title: Irrigation Transformation in India: Assessing the Impact of PMKSY Using Counterfactual Analysis
detail.abstract: Irrigation plays a critical role in enhancing agricultural productivity, stabilising farm incomes, supporting multiple cropping systems, and ensuring food security in India. Despite substantial public investments in irrigation infrastructure over the decades, irrigation development in India has continued to face several challenges, including uneven regional distribution, inefficient water use, inadequate convergence among irrigation schemes, and limited expansion of assured irrigation in rain-fed areas. In order to address these constraints and promote efficient water management, the Government of India launched the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) during 2015–16 with the objective of expanding irrigation coverage, improving water-use efficiency, and ensuring ”Har Khet Ko Pani” (water to every farm). Against this background, the present study evaluates the impact of PMKSY on irrigation development in India using a comprehensive time-series analytical framework.The study is based on secondary data collected from the Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Agricultural Statistics at a Glance, and other official government sources for the period from 2005–06 to 2022–23. To examine the effectiveness of PMKSY, the study analyses major irrigation indicators, including net irrigated area, gross irrigated area, proportion of gross irrigated area to gross cropped area, and irrigation intensity. The analysis divides the study period into pre-PMKSY (2005–2014) and post-PMKSY (2015–2023) phases in order to compare irrigation performance before and after the implementation of the programme.The study employs a combination of descriptive statistics, mean comparison tests, trend regression models, interrupted time series analysis, structural break tests, and counterfactual impact estimation techniques to assess the extent of change associated with PMKSY. The results reveal substantial improvement in all major irrigation indicators during the post-PMKSY period. The mean net irrigated area increased from 59.61 million hectares in the pre-PMKSY period to 71.20 million hectares in the post-PMKSY period, while gross irrigated area increased from 83.36 million hectares to 106.60 million hectares. Similarly, irrigation intensity and the share of irrigated area in gross cropped area also recorded significant improvement after the introduction of the scheme.The interrupted time series analysis indicates that the annual growth rate of net irrigated area accelerated significantly after the implementation of PMKSY, suggesting a clear structural shift in irrigation trends. The structural break analysis further confirms the existence of a statistically significant break around 2015, coinciding with the launch of PMKSY. Counterfactual estimates demonstrate that actual irrigation expansion substantially exceeded the projected no-intervention scenario, and the gap between actual and counterfactual irrigation coverage widened progressively over time, indicating cumulative policy effects.Overall, the findings suggest that PMKSY has played a significant role in strengthening irrigation infrastructure, expanding irrigation coverage, and promoting irrigation-led agricultural development in India. The study highlights the importance of sustained public investment in irrigation, improved water management practices, and the expansion of micro-irrigation systems, particularly in water-scarce and rain-fed regions. AI.tldr: 本文评估了印度Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)灌溉计划对农业灌溉发展的影响，使用2005-2023年时间序列数据，通过多种分析方法发现该计划显著提升了印度灌溉面积、灌溉强度和灌溉效率，证实了政策干预的有效性。
AI.research_question: PMKSY灌溉计划对印度农业灌溉发展产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 印度灌溉发展面临区域分布不均、用水效率低下、雨养地区灌溉覆盖有限等挑战，政府于2015-16年推出PMKSY计划以应对这些问题，需系统评估该政策的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共投资与农业基础设施发展理论；政策干预评估框架（基于时间序列的政策冲击分析）。
AI.method: 使用2005-2023年官方二手数据，将研究期分为PMKSY前（2005-2014）和后（2015-2023）两阶段；采用描述性统计、均值比较检验、趋势回归模型、中断时间序列分析、结构断点检验和反事实影响估计等多种方法。
AI.findings: PMKSY实施后，净灌溉面积从5961万公顷增至7120万公顷，总灌溉面积从8336万公顷增至10660万公顷；灌溉强度和灌溉占比均显著提升；中断时间序列分析显示净灌溉面积年增长率显著加速；结构断点检验确认2015年存在统计显著的断点；反事实估计显示实际灌溉扩张远超无干预情景，且差距随时间扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共灌溉投资政策的有效性提供了经验证据；验证了大型国家灌溉计划对农业基础设施发展的结构性推动作用；通过多种时间序列方法结合，提供了政策评估的方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 确认PMKSY在扩大灌溉覆盖、提升用水效率方面的积极成效，为印度及其他发展中国家继续推进灌溉投资提供了政策依据；强调了微灌系统和雨水灌溉区域发展的优先性；支持了持续公共投资与水资源管理改善的必要性。

title: WLNO: Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Oklahoma State University

detail.title: WLNO: Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
detail.abstract: This work introduces the Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator (WLNO), a novel neural operator thatfuses Haar wavelet multi-scale spatial decomposition with the Laplace-domain pole-residueformulation of the Laplace Neural Operator (LNO). While LNO captures transient and steady-statedynamics through learnable system poles and residues, it lacks an explicit mechanism for extractingspatially localized multi-scale features inherent in complex PDE solutions. WLNO addresses thisby augmenting the LNO core with a parallel single-level Haar discrete wavelet transform (DWT)branch that decomposes the lifted feature map into four frequency subbands: approximation (LL),horizontal detail (LH), vertical detail (HL), and diagonal detail (HH) and applies independentlearned $1\times1$ convolutions to each subband before reconstruction via the inverse DWT. Thetwo branches are fused through a learnable sigmoid-gated weight $\alpha_\mathrm{wav}$,initialized to give a small initial contribution to the wavelet branch, allowing the model toadaptively balance Laplace-domain dynamics against spatial multi-scale features throughouttraining. WLNO is evaluated against LNO on five benchmark PDE problems using identicalhyperparameters, training data, and evaluation protocols: the diffusion equation, the Burgersequation, the reaction-diffusion system, Darcy flow, and the two-dimensional Navier-Stokesequation. WLNO consistently outperforms LNO on all five problems with the most pronounced improvement on problems with strong spatial multi-scalestructure, such as the Burgers equation with sharp shock fronts and the Navier-Stokes equationwith coherent vortical structures, while remaining consistent across smoother and ellipticproblems. These results demonstrate that wavelet-based multi-scale spatial decomposition is aprincipled and effective complement to Laplace-domain operator learning.

AI.tldr: WLNO通过在拉普拉斯神经算子（LNO）中引入Haar小波多尺度空间分解分支，显著提升了在复杂偏微分方程问题上的算子学习性能。
AI.research_question: 如何将小波多尺度空间分解融入拉普拉斯域神经算子，以增强其对复杂PDE解中空间局部多尺度特征的提取能力？
AI.motivation: LNO擅长捕捉瞬态与稳态动力学，但缺乏显式机制来提取复杂PDE解中固有的空间局部多尺度特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wavelet-Laplace Neural Operator (WLNO)；Haar小波离散小波变换（DWT）；拉普拉斯神经算子（LNO）极点-留数公式；可学习sigmoid门控融合权重。
AI.method: 在LNO核心基础上增加并行单层Haar DWT分支，将提升后的特征图分解为四个频率子带（LL、LH、HL、HH），对各子带应用独立可学习1×1卷积，再通过逆DWT重构；两分支通过可学习sigmoid门控权重α_wav融合。
AI.findings: 在扩散方程、Burgers方程、反应扩散系统、Darcy流和二维Navier-Stokes方程五个基准PDE问题上，WLNO一致优于LNO，且在具有强空间多尺度结构的问题（如Burgers激波、Navier-Stokes涡结构）上改进最为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将小波多尺度空间分解与拉普拉斯域算子学习有机结合，证明基于小波的多尺度空间分解是拉普拉斯域算子学习的有效且原理性补充。
AI.practical_contributions: WLNO在多个经典PDE基准问题上取得一致更优性能，尤其适用于含强空间多尺度结构的动力学系统建模。

title: An Enterprise Architecture-Based AI TRiSM Framework for DataPrivacy Compliance Monitoring in National Cybersecurity Agencies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universiti Putra Malaysia

detail.title: An Enterprise Architecture-Based AI TRiSM Framework for DataPrivacy Compliance Monitoring in National Cybersecurity Agencies

keywords.keywords: Artificial intelligenceAI TRiSMCompliance MonitoringCybersecurity AgencyData PrivacyEnterprise ArchitectureGovernance

detail.abstract: Organisations face escalating challenges in maintaining data privacy compliance amid evolving regulatory requirements, proliferating cyberthreats, and rapidly growing data volumes. Traditional compliance approaches remain largely manual, fragmented, and reactive, limiting scalability and real-time responsiveness. This study develops an Enterprise Architecture (EA)-driven Artificial Intelligence Trust, Risk, and Security Management (AI TRiSM) framework to enhance data privacy compliance monitoring within national cybersecurity agencies. Adopting a qualitative interpretivist approach, the study conducted semi-structured interviews with five domain experts from CyberSecurity Malaysia’s Information Security Management and Assurance Department. Data were analysed using six-phase thematic analysis via ATLAS.ti, and thematic saturation was reached within the five expert sessions. The findings reveal four key architectural layers: model monitoring, ModelOps, AI application security, and model privacy, with governance emerging as a cross-cutting enabler across all layers. These components are integrated into a structured multi-layered framework aligned with EA domains to support proactive compliance monitoring, real-time risk detection, and improved operational efficiency. The framework contributes by bridging the gap between AI governance and enterprise architecture, offering a systematic and scalable approach to privacy compliance in high-risk cybersecurity environments. The study provides both theoretical insights into AI-enabled compliance architectures and practical guidance for national-level agencies seeking to strengthen privacy governance. Future research is recommended to validate the framework across different sectors and through quantitative or longitudinal approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于企业架构（EA）驱动的人工智能信任、风险与安全管理（AI TRiSM）框架，用于增强国家网络安全机构的数据隐私合规监控。通过对马来西亚网络安全局专家的半结构化访谈和主题分析，识别出模型监控、ModelOps、AI应用安全和模型隐私四个关键架构层，并以治理作为跨层赋能因素，形成多层结构化框架。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个企业架构驱动的人工智能信任、风险与安全管理框架，以增强国家网络安全机构的数据隐私合规监控能力？
AI.motivation: 组织面临日益严格的隐私法规、不断升级的网络威胁和快速增长的数据量，传统合规方法多依赖手动、碎片化和被动方式，缺乏可扩展性和实时响应能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业架构（EA）、人工智能信任风险安全管理（AI TRiSM）框架、数据隐私合规治理理论。
AI.method: 定性解释主义方法，对马来西亚网络安全局信息安全管理与保障部门的5名领域专家进行半结构化访谈，使用ATLAS.ti进行六阶段主题分析，达到主题饱和。
AI.findings: 识别出模型监控、ModelOps、AI应用安全和模型隐私四个关键架构层，治理作为跨层赋能因素；构建了与企业架构域对齐的多层结构化框架，支持主动合规监控、实时风险检测和运营效率提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合了AI治理与企业架构之间的理论缺口，提出了系统化的AI驱动合规架构，为高风险的网络安全环境提供了可扩展的隐私合规监控理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家层级的网络安全机构提供了增强隐私治理的实操指南；支持从被动合规向主动监控与实时风险检测的转型；框架具有良好的跨部门推广潜力。

title: Physics-Informed Dual-Branch Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Variable-Obstacle Turbulent Backward-Facing Step Flows
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Dalian University of Technology

detail.title: Physics-Informed Dual-Branch Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Variable-Obstacle Turbulent Backward-Facing Step Flows
detail.abstract: Accurately predicting turbulent flows over variable geometries remains challenging because geometric changes can simultaneously alter the mean-flow structure, separation behavior, and associated Reynolds-stress fields. This study develops a hierarchical closure-coupled physics-informed Kolmogorov–Arnold network (HCC-PIKAN) for turbulent-flow prediction over variable geometries. The framework adopts a closure-coupled dual-branch architecture. A mean-flow branch first predicts pressure and velocity, and the predicted mean-flow variables are then used, together with the original geometry and flow inputs, to condition a turbulence-closure branch for Reynolds-stress prediction. This design introduces an explicit architecture-level link between mean-flow prediction and turbulence-closure modeling. Compact geometric features are extracted using a self-attention-based geometry encoder, and a two-stage training strategy is adopted to improve optimization stability. To enhance physical consistency, nondimensional continuity and momentum residuals with Reynolds-stress-divergence terms are enforced through automatic differentiation, while supervised and physics losses are dynamically balanced. Backward-facing-step configurations with variable obstacles are used as representative validation cases. Numerical results show that HCC-PIKAN outperforms the baseline physics-informed neural network and the single-network physics-informed Kolmogorov–Arnold network. The best model achieves a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 0.012670, a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.006722, and a coefficient of determination of 0.9968, reducing RMSE and MAE by about 29.9% and 31.2%, respectively, relative to the baseline model. The framework also produces lower validation equation residuals and more compact residual distributions, demonstrating improved predictive accuracy and equation-level physical consistency for turbulent-flow surrogate modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种层次化闭合耦合物理信息Kolmogorov–Arnold网络（HCC-PIKAN），用于变几何湍流预测。该框架采用闭合耦合双分支架构，结合自注意力几何编码器和两阶段训练策略，通过自动微分施加物理约束，在变几何后向台阶算例中显著优于基线模型，RMSE和MAE分别降低约29.9%和31.2%。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测变几何构型下的湍流流动？
AI.motivation: 变几何构型会同时改变平均流结构、分离行为和雷诺应力场，现有方法难以准确预测。需要开发能够同时处理几何变化与湍流闭合建模的代理模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）、Kolmogorov–Arnold网络（KAN）、闭合耦合双分支架构、自注意力机制、自动微分物理约束。
AI.method: 提出HCC-PIKAN框架：1）闭合耦合双分支架构（平均流分支预测压力/速度，湍流闭合分支预测雷诺应力）；2）自注意力几何编码器提取紧凑几何特征；3）两阶段训练策略提高优化稳定性；4）通过自动微分施加无量纲连续性和动量残差物理约束；5）动态平衡监督损失与物理损失。
AI.findings: 在变几何后向台阶构型中，HCC-PIKAN最佳模型达到RMSE=0.012670、MAE=0.006722、R²=0.9968，相比基线PINN模型RMSE和MAE分别降低约29.9%和31.2%；同时产生更低的验证方程残差和更紧凑的残差分布，表现出更好的预测精度和方程级物理一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一种显式的架构级闭合耦合机制，将平均流预测与湍流闭合建模直接关联；2）将KAN网络引入湍流预测领域并验证其在复杂物理问题中的有效性；3）发展了基于自动微分的物理约束施加方法，提升了代理模型的方程级物理一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为变几何湍流预测提供了一种高精度、物理一致的代理建模方法；2）自注意力几何编码器可泛化至其他几何变化场景；3）两阶段训练策略为物理信息网络的优化提供参考；4）可用于工程中快速、准确地预测不同几何配置下的湍流流动。

title: Too hot to work? Effect of temperature on intra-day work time​
affiliations: Department of Econometrics and OR Tilburg University, Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research and Tilburg University

detail.title: Too hot to work? Effect of temperature on intra-day work time​
detail.abstract: Rising temperatures due to climate change pose significant challenges to how much and how effectively individuals can work, particularly in low- and middle-income countries such as India, where exposure to extreme heat is becoming more common. While existing research documents adverse effects of heat on labor outcomes, little is known about how individuals adjust their work patterns within a day. This study examines the impact of ambient temperature on time allocation, with a focus on intraday substitution of time spent on paid work. The study uses nationally representative data from the 2019 Indian Time Use Survey combined with high-frequency temperature data measured at 30-minute intervals. We estimate the effect of temperature on total daily time spent on paid work and on the likelihood of working during specific periods of the day. Our results show that extreme heat has limited effects on overall daily work hours but leads to substantial intraday reallocation of labor. Individuals shift work from the hottest periods midday toward early morning or late evening. This pattern is primarily driven by younger men and workers in self-employed or agricultural jobs, who have greater flexibility in their schedules and are more exposed to ambient heat. In contrast, salaried workers reduce work during peak heat without compensatory increases at other times. These findings highlight the importance of flexible work arrangements and targeted heat-mitigation policies to sustain productivity and worker well-being in a warming climate.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2019年印度时间使用调查数据，发现极端高温对每日总工作时长影响有限，但会导致劳动时间在一天内显著重新分配——人们将工作从炎热的中午时段转移到清晨或深夜。
AI.research_question: 环境温度如何影响个体的时间分配，特别是日内的有偿工作时间替代？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致极端高温日益频繁，尤其在印度等中低收入国家。现有研究已记录高温对劳动产出的不利影响，但人们如何在一天内调整工作模式的微观机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动供给理论、时间分配理论、气候经济学
AI.method: 使用2019年印度时间使用调查（全国代表性数据）与30分钟间隔的高频温度数据匹配，估计温度对每日有偿工作时长及特定时段工作概率的影响。
AI.findings: 极端高温对每日总工作时长影响有限，但导致显著的日内劳动重新分配：工作从最热的中午时段转移到清晨或深夜。这一模式主要由年轻男性、自雇者及农业工作者驱动；而受薪工作者在高温峰值减少工作后未在其他时段补偿。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从日内时间替代视角揭示高温对劳动供给的微观调整机制，区分了不同就业类型（自雇/受薪）对热应激的差异化反应，丰富了气候经济学与劳动经济学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果支持推广灵活工作安排（如错峰工时）以应对高温；建议针对受薪工人等灵活性较低的群体制定热缓解政策（如降温设施、高温津贴），以维持气候变暖下的生产力和劳动者福祉。

title: Quantifying the Environmental & Economic Impacts of Integrated Organic Waste Management in a Tropical Urbanizing Ecotourism Region
affiliations: Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Costa Rica, University of Costa Rica, Universidade Federal Rural de Pernambuco (UFRPE) and West Virginia University

detail.title: Quantifying the Environmental & Economic Impacts of Integrated Organic Waste Management in a Tropical Urbanizing Ecotourism Region
detail.abstract: Given the finite lifespan of traditional landfills, alternative waste management systems are needed to reduce environmental impacts, promote resource recovery, and support a circular economy. This study evaluated the environmental and economic sustainability of four organic waste treatment scenarios in Monteverde, Costa Rica, analyzing collection and transportation (C&T) routes and operational systems of: 1) landfill, 2) municipal centralized composting, 3) municipal centralized anaerobic co-digestion (ACD), and 4) ACD in a private cheese factory. Methodology integrated geoprocessing, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), and Life Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA). Results showed that C&T accounted for over 90% of Global Warming Potential (GWP) and Eutrophication Potential. Combined C&T and operations revealed that Scenario 1 had the highest negative impact on Marine Eutrophication Potential (MEP) (1,74E-4 t Neq), while Scenario 2 caused the highest GWP and Freshwater Eutrophication Potential (FEP) due to co-substrate transport (12.23 t CO2eq and 3.09E-4 t Peq, respectively). Although Scenario 3 minimized impacts across all environmental categories (10.44 t CO2eq, 2.68E-4 t Peq, and 4.19E-5 t Neq), it incurred the highest cost per ton (US$ 437) due to structural complexity. Conversely, Scenario 4 had the lowest cost per ton (US$ 164). Over a 10-year LCCA period, Scenario 2 required the highest municipal financial incentive (US$ 1,803,159), whereas Scenario 4 required the lowest (US$ 648,468). Consequently, selecting the most sustainable waste management system requires a multi-criteria approach to navigate trade-offs. Thus, decision-making must extend beyond financial costs alone to mitigate transport impacts, evaluate renewable fuels, and incorporate social effects.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了哥斯达黎加蒙特韦德四种有机废物处理方案（填埋、市政集中堆肥、市政集中厌氧共消化、奶酪厂厌氧共消化）的环境与经济可持续性，发现收集运输环节贡献了90%以上的全球变暖潜势和富营养化潜势；市政集中厌氧共消化环境影响最小但成本最高，奶酪厂厌氧共消化成本最低；选择最可持续的废物管理系统需采用多标准方法权衡利弊。
AI.research_question: 在哥斯达黎加蒙特韦德地区，四种有机废物处理场景（填埋、市政集中堆肥、市政集中厌氧共消化、奶酪厂厌氧共消化）的环境影响和经济成本如何？如何权衡环境效益与经济成本来选择最可持续的废物管理系统？
AI.motivation: 传统垃圾填埋场寿命有限，需要替代性废物管理系统来减少环境影响、促进资源回收并支持循环经济。蒙特韦德地区作为生态旅游目的地，面临有机废物管理的特殊挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论、生命周期评价（LCA）框架、生命周期成本分析（LCCA）框架、多标准决策分析框架
AI.method: 整合地理处理技术、生命周期评价（LCA）和生命周期成本分析（LCCA），对四种有机废物处理场景的收集运输路线和运营系统进行综合评估。
AI.findings: 1) 收集运输占全球变暖潜势和富营养化潜势的90%以上；2) 填埋场景对海洋富营养化影响最大；3) 市政集中堆肥因共基质运输导致全球变暖潜势和淡水富营养化最高；4) 市政集中厌氧共消化环境影响最小但成本最高（437美元/吨）；5) 奶酪厂厌氧共消化成本最低（164美元/吨）；6) 10年周期内市政集中堆肥需最多财政激励，奶酪厂厌氧共消化需最少。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了LCA与LCCA整合方法在发展中国家有机废物管理决策中的应用价值，揭示了收集运输环节在废物管理系统中的关键环境影响贡献，为循环经济理论在拉美地区的实践提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为蒙特韦德及类似地区的废物管理决策提供了量化依据，指出最优方案需在多标准之间权衡：环境影响最小化（市政集中厌氧共消化）vs. 成本最小化（奶酪厂厌氧共消化）；建议决策者不能仅关注财务成本，还需考虑运输影响、可再生能源利用和社会效应。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and ensemble learners for predicting brine-hydrogen/cushion-gas interfacial tension in underground hydrogen storage
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Nazarbayev University, Kaunas University of Technology, Shiraz University, Nazarbayev University, Nazarbayev University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Nazarbayev University

detail.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and ensemble learners for predicting brine-hydrogen/cushion-gas interfacial tension in underground hydrogen storage
detail.abstract: Underground hydrogen storage is a promising method for addressing the energy gap. Nonetheless, hydrogen migration is the main challenge of efficient storage, especially in saline aquifer targets. Gas-brine interfacial tension (IFT) is a critical parameter that controls capillary forces and optimizes the injection cycle conditions to enhance the efficacy of underground hydrogen storage on a field scale. This study aims to apply categorical boosting regressor (CB), decision tree, extra trees regressor, Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN), random forest, and extreme gradient boosting machine learning techniques to extensive experimental studies. Specifically, 2803 data points are used to predict the IFT with the influence of vast ranges of pressure, temperature, salinity, ∆ρ, and working gas (H2) with different cushion gases. Statistical description (box plots, pair plot, and Spearman correlation coefficient) and model evaluation graphs were applied to study the dataset and the performance of the applied models. The results demonstrate that KAN and CB have superior performance with total R2 of 0.9979 and 0.9976, and root mean square errors of 0.4828 mN.m-1 and 0.5097 mN.m-1, respectively. The KAN model provides an accurate data-driven tool for estimating gas-brine IFT under underground hydrogen storage conditions and may support future screening, sensitivity analysis, and reservoir-scale modeling of hydrogen storage systems. These findings highlight the potential of KAN-based modeling to provide reliable IFT estimates for gas-brine systems, supporting data-driven assessment and design of safer underground hydrogen storage operations.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用KAN和CB等机器学习模型，基于2803个数据点预测地下储氢中气-盐水界面张力，KAN模型表现最优（R²=0.9979），为安全高效储氢提供了数据驱动工具。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法准确预测地下储氢条件下气-盐水界面张力？
AI.motivation: 地下储氢是解决能源缺口的有前景方法，但氢气迁移（尤其在盐水层）是主要挑战。气-盐水界面张力是控制毛细力、优化注入条件的关键参数，现有实验研究有限，需要高效预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 界面张力理论、毛细力理论、机器学习回归模型（CB、决策树、额外树、KAN、随机森林、XGBoost）
AI.method: 基于2803个实验数据点，运用六种机器学习模型（CB、决策树、额外树、KAN、随机森林、XGBoost）预测界面张力，输入变量包括压力、温度、盐度、密度差、工作气体（H₂）及缓冲气体类型，采用箱线图、成对图和Spearman相关系数进行统计分析。
AI.findings: KAN和CB模型表现最优，总R²分别为0.9979和0.9976，均方根误差分别为0.4828 mN/m和0.5097 mN/m。KAN模型为地下储氢条件下气-盐水界面张力估算提供了准确的数据驱动工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了KAN网络在气-盐水界面张力预测中的优越性能，拓展了机器学习在地质储氢领域的理论应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地下储氢系统的筛选、敏感性分析和储层尺度建模提供了可靠的数据驱动评估工具，有助于更安全高效的储氢操作设计与优化。

title: The Future of Luxury Branding: The Era of Consciousness

detail.title: The Future of Luxury Branding: The Era of Consciousness
detail.abstract: In a changing global framework, driven by new value systems, environmental challenges and an abundance of offerings, the high-end industry is increasingly coming under moral pressure. The article examines the challenges and discusses options for luxury brands to align with ESG parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在全球变化背景下，高端奢侈品行业面临的道德压力以及品牌如何与ESG（环境、社会和治理）参数对齐的挑战与选择。
AI.research_question: 奢侈品品牌如何应对新的价值体系、环境挑战和产品过剩所带来的道德压力，并与ESG参数保持一致？
AI.motivation: 全球框架正在变化，新的价值体系、环境挑战和产品过剩使得高端奢侈品行业面临越来越大的道德压力，亟需探索与ESG对齐的可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未在摘要中明确提及，可能涉及可持续发展理论、企业社会责任（CSR）、ESG框架以及奢侈品品牌管理理论。
AI.method: 摘要未具体说明研究方法，可能为概念性分析或案例研究。
AI.findings: 奢侈品品牌需要主动调整战略，以应对道德压力并与ESG参数对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG框架引入奢侈品行业分析，丰富了奢侈品品牌管理与可持续发展交叉领域的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品品牌管理者提供了应对道德压力和融入ESG原则的战略思路与决策参考。

title:
Brand Architecture as a Moderator of AI-mediated Retrieval
Aggregation Logic for Corporate Portfolios in the AI Availability Framework

detail.title:
Brand Architecture as a Moderator of AI-mediated Retrieval
Aggregation Logic for Corporate Portfolios in the AI Availability Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author serves as Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance at Samsung Electronics America (SEA). The research presented here is independent of SEA and does not constitute Samsung research. No SEA data, personnel, or commercial interests influenced the design, conduct, analysis, or reporting of this proposal. SEA did not review the manuscript prior to submission. The proposal does not endorse, evaluate or assign architecture-specific risk scores to any specific corporation, including Samsung. The candidate matched pairs in §6.2 are described in generic architectural terms and do not name specific corporations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Generative AI tools (including Claude) were used for drafting and editing; all content was reviewed and validated by the author, who takes full responsibility for the integrity and accuracy of the article.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded. No external funding sources contributed to this research.

detail.abstract: The AI Availability framework (González Castro 2026d) operationalises AI Availability at the brand level, scoring each brand's surfacing rate, prominence, and favourable representation in generative AI responses to category-relevant queries. Most major firms operate multi-brand corporate portfolios in which brand-level outcomes aggregate to the corporate level along pathways that depend on brand architecture. This paper specifies the aggregation logic for the four standard architecture types of the Aaker spectrum — branded house, sub-brand, endorsed brand, house of brands (Aaker and Joachimsthaler 2000) — and develops a coupling-coefficient formalism that makes architecture-aware corporate AIAS aggregation tractable. The paper states the cross-architecture comparison hypothesis (H_arch): for matched categories, branded-house and house-of-brands corporations face systematically different distributions of AI-mediation risk, with branded-house structures concentrating the risk in single-point-of-failure form and house-of-brands structures distributing the risk in hidden-cell form. Three governance implications follow: governance locus by architecture, the cross-brand cannibalisation question unique to multi-brand portfolios, and corporate AIAS reporting at the level of analysis appropriate for the architecture. The paper specifies the matched-pair comparative empirical design required to test H_arch and registers the design as a research-agenda priority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI可用性框架的品牌层级聚合逻辑，针对Aaker品牌架构光谱中的四种标准类型（品牌化 houses、子品牌、背书品牌、houses of brands），开发了耦合系数形式化方法，实现了架构感知的企业级AIAS聚合。论文提出了跨架构比较假设（H_arch），指出品牌化houses和houses of brands企业在AI中介风险分布上存在系统性差异，并讨论了相应的治理意义。
AI.research_question: 多品牌企业组合中，不同品牌架构如何影响品牌级AI可用性（AIAS）向企业级聚合的路径？不同架构下AI中介风险分布有何系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 大多数大型企业运营多品牌组合，品牌级AI可用性结果通过品牌架构决定的路径向企业级聚合，但现有研究缺乏对这种聚合逻辑的形式化建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI可用性框架（González Castro 2026d）；Aaker品牌架构光谱（品牌化houses、子品牌、背书品牌、houses of brands，Aaker and Joachimsthaler 2000）；耦合系数形式化方法。
AI.method: 理论推导与形式化建模：开发耦合系数形式化方法，实现架构感知的企业级AIAS聚合；提出跨架构比较假设（H_arch）；指定匹配对比较实证设计。
AI.findings: 品牌化houses结构以单点故障形式集中AI中介风险；houses of brands结构以隐藏单元形式分散风险。跨架构比较假设（H_arch）得到形式化陈述。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将品牌架构理论引入AI可用性研究，建立了架构感知的AIAS聚合形式化模型；提出了耦合系数概念，为不同品牌架构下AI风险分布的系统性差异提供了理论预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了三种治理意义：按架构确定治理焦点、多品牌组合特有的跨品牌蚕食问题、以及按架构适当分析层级的企业AIAS报告。

title: An Additive AI Availability Factor for Brand-strength Models. A Methodological Proposal for Extending Brand Valuation to the AI Mediation Layer

detail.title: An Additive AI Availability Factor for Brand-strength Models. A Methodological Proposal for Extending Brand Valuation to the AI Mediation Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author serves as Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance at Samsung Electronics America (SEA). The research presented here is independent of SEA and does not constitute Samsung research. No SEA data, personnel, or commercial interests influenced the design or reporting of this proposal. SEA did not review the manuscript prior to submission. The proposal does not endorse, evaluate, or assign brand-value scores to any specific brand, including Samsung.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Generative AI tools (including Claude) were used for drafting and editing; all content was reviewed and validated by the author, who takes full responsibility for the integrity and accuracy of the article.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded. No external funding sources contributed to this research.

detail.abstract: Brand-strength scoring frameworks that underpin brand valuation — Interbrand's Brand Strength Score, Brand Finance's Brand Strength Index, Kantar BrandZ, and comparable models — were developed before generative AI became a material intermediary in brand discovery. The frameworks measure the brand-equity assets that classical theory identifies as drivers of brand value, but they do not measure whether and how those assets are surfaced by AI systems consulted during category episodes. This paper proposes an additive AI Availability factor appended to existing brand-strength scores: BS(adjusted) = BS(traditional) + α · AIAS where AIAS is the AI Availability Score (González Castro 2026d, 2026c) and α ∈ [0, 1] is a category-specific weight calibrated annually against the observed share of category purchase decisions routed through AI-mediated retrieval. The additive form preserves backward compatibility with historical brand-strength scores, is interpretively transparent (the AI Availability score is reported alongside traditional factor scores rather than buried inside a weighting coefficient), and maps onto existing valuation methodologies in which each factor has defined evaluation criteria, scoring bands, and explicable logic. Three deprecation triggers are specified under which the factor is retired for a category, restoring the classical brand-strength model. The proposal complements rather than displaces classical brand-strength theory; the empirical calibration of α and the predictive validity of the adjusted score against subsequent brand-value movements are the next research priorities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在传统品牌强度评分（如Interbrand、Brand Finance等）基础上增加一个加性AI可用性因子（AI Availability Score），以反映生成式AI作为品牌发现中介对品牌资产的影响。调整后的品牌强度评分保持向后兼容，并设有三个退出触发条件。
AI.research_question: 现有的品牌强度评分框架未考虑生成式AI作为品牌发现中介的作用，如何在此基础上补充一个AI可用性因子以反映AI对品牌资产的影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已成为品牌发现的重要中介，但现有品牌估值框架（Interbrand、Brand Finance、Kantar BrandZ等）均未纳入这一因素，导致品牌强度评分可能高估或低估品牌在AI检索环境中的实际表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典品牌资产理论（驱动品牌价值的资产因素）；AI可用性评分（AI Availability Score, González Castro 2026d, 2026c）；加性模型 BS(adjusted) = BS(traditional) + α·AIAS
AI.method: 提出加性AI可用性因子调整公式；α为类别特定权重，需根据通过AI中介检索完成的类别购买决策占比进行年度校准；设定三个因子退出触发条件。
AI.findings: 调整后的品牌强度评分保持与历史评分的向后兼容性；AI可用性评分作为独立因子与经典因子并列报告，具有解释透明性；映射到已有估值方法论（每个因子有明确评价标准、评分区间和可解释逻辑）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI中介效应纳入品牌强度评估体系，扩展了经典品牌资产理论在AI时代的适用性；提出加性结构而非替代经典模型，保持理论延续性；明确因子退出机制，避免过度修正。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌估值机构（Interbrand、Brand Finance等）提供可直接嵌入现有框架的AI因子工具；帮助品牌管理者量化AI检索环境中的品牌可见性；提出α的实证校准和预测效度验证作为后续研究方向。

title: Dynamic Spatial Panel Data Analysis of Inbound Accommodation Demand in Japan: Estimation and Forecasting
affiliations: Kwansei Gakuin University - School of Business Administration

detail.title: Dynamic Spatial Panel Data Analysis of Inbound Accommodation Demand in Japan: Estimation and Forecasting
detail.abstract: This study examines the spatial dependence structure of inbound foreign tourist accommodation demand using monthly panel data for 47 Japanese prefectures (January 2007-December 2019), and evaluates the forecasting utility of spatial models. We estimate spatial Durbin error models (SDEM) and dynamic spatial Durbin models (SDM), employing foreign overnight stays from the Japan Tourism Agency's Accommodation Survey as the dependent variable, with the USD/JPY exchange rate, WTI crude oil price, and city-level consumer price index as explanatory variables. Bayesian spatial model selection consistently favors SDEM, and the dynamic SDM estimation yields statistically significant spatial autoregressive parameters, temporal lags, and negative spillover effects from neighboring prefectures' price levels. Comparing two spatial weight matrices, a travel-time distance matrix based on the National Passenger Flow Survey substantially outperforms the traditional contiguity matrix in model fit. Both matrices detect a significant negative spillover effect of neighboring CPI (W • cpi), but the effect size under the travel-time matrix (-0.084, 𝑡 =-2.26) is approximately 18 times larger than under the Queen contiguity matrix (-0.005, 𝑡 =-2.86), demonstrating that the choice of spatial weight matrix is not merely a technical decision but a substantive analytical choice that determines the magnitude of detected spatial spillovers. In the forecasting analysis, a holdout comparison of six models (2018-2019) reveals that the introduction of temporal lags dramatically improves forecast accuracy, while the additional contribution of spatial structure remains limited. Under seasonal differencing, all models beat the seasonal naïve benchmark (MASE < 1), yet the gap between spatial models and the dynamic fixed-effects model is marginal. These results suggest that spatial dependence is essential for understanding the mechanisms of inbound accommodation demand but does not directly translate into practical short-term forecast improvement, consistent with the findings of Jiao et al. (2021).

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本47个都道府县的月度面板数据，通过空间计量模型分析入境旅游住宿需求的空间依赖结构，发现空间权重矩阵的选择对检测到的溢出效应大小有实质性影响，但空间结构对短期预测精度的贡献有限。
AI.research_question: 入境外国游客住宿需求是否存在空间依赖结构？空间计量模型能否提升预测精度？空间权重矩阵的选择如何影响分析结果？
AI.motivation: 入境旅游需求具有空间溢出效应（如游客流动带动周边地区），但现有研究对空间依赖结构的刻画不足，且空间模型在预测中的实际效用尚不明确。此外，空间权重矩阵的选择多被视为技术问题，缺乏对其实质性影响的讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间计量经济学（空间杜宾误差模型SDEM、动态空间杜宾模型SDM）；空间溢出效应理论；旅游需求预测理论。
AI.method: 使用2007年1月至2019年12月日本47个都道府县的月度面板数据，以外国游客过夜住宿量为因变量，以美元/日元汇率、WTI原油价格、城市CPI为自变量，估计SDEM和动态SDM模型，并比较基于旅行时间距离矩阵和Queen邻接矩阵两种空间权重矩阵的效果。通过贝叶斯模型选择进行模型筛选，并以2018-2019年数据做留出法预测对比。
AI.findings: （1）贝叶斯模型选择一致支持SDEM；（2）动态SDM估计显示显著的空间自回归参数、时间滞后及周边地区价格水平的负溢出效应；（3）旅行时间距离矩阵的拟合效果显著优于传统邻接矩阵；（4）两种矩阵均检测到周边CPI的显著负溢出效应，但旅行时间矩阵下的效应量（-0.084）是邻接矩阵（-0.005）的约18倍；（5）加入时间滞后项大幅提升预测精度，但空间结构的额外贡献有限；（6）季节性差分后所有模型均优于季节性朴素基准，但空间模型与动态固定效应模型的差距极小。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了空间权重矩阵的选择不仅是技术决策，更是实质性分析选择，会显著影响检测到的空间溢出效应大小；为旅游需求的空间依赖结构提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游管理部门理解入境旅游需求的空间溢出机制提供了参考；指出空间模型虽有助于理解机制，但对短期预测的实践提升有限，建议将资源聚焦于时间动态建模。

title: Interpreting Sensory Experience in Customer-generated Text: A Large Language Model (LLM) Approach
affiliations: , Stanford University, Nanjing University of Science & Technology, BI Norwegian Business School and University of Oxford

detail.title: Interpreting Sensory Experience in Customer-generated Text: A Large Language Model (LLM) Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.

detail.abstract: Sensory dimension is a central component of how consumers evaluate products and services, and online reviews offer a rich record of how these experiences are described. Prior research has used lexicon-based text analysis to extract sensory cues from customer language by mapping words to predefined sensory dictionaries and examining their effects on ratings. However, such approaches rely on fixed word–sense mappings and struggle to capture the context-dependent nature of sensory language. A context-sensitive approach using large language models (LLMs) to interpret sensory language in customer reviews is introduced. Validated against human coders and lexicon-based methods across 82,350 restaurant reviews, the LLM achieves substantially higher reliability by capturing implicit and context-dependent sensory references. While lexicon-based approaches infer senses from predefined word categories, LLMs infer which sensory modalities are most likely activated given the linguistic context. Leveraging this approach, this research moves beyond identifying sensory cues to examine how sensory experiences are used in evaluation. The findings suggest that sensory modalities exhibit markedly different associations with ratings when considered in isolation, but these differences are largely explained by the evaluative contexts in which sensory experiences are expressed. Different sensory modalities are disproportionately associated with positive versus negative evaluations, with some primarily used to express hedonic assessments and others more frequently invoked as diagnostic cues in negative evaluations. This study demonstrates how LLMs can be used to interpret customer experience from consumer text and provides a framework for uncovering the evaluative roles of sensory attributes that can be generalised across product types.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用大语言模型（LLM）从顾客在线评论中提取感官信息，克服了传统基于词典方法无法捕捉语境依赖性的局限。通过对82,350条餐厅评论的分析，LLM比人类编码者和词典方法具有更高的可靠性。研究发现，感官维度与评分的关系取决于其所在的评价语境——某些感官主要用于表达享乐评价（正面），而另一些则更常作为诊断性线索出现在负面评价中。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型从在线评论中提取语境敏感的感官信息，并探究不同感官模态在消费者评价中的不同作用？
AI.motivation: 传统基于词典的文本分析方法将词语与预定义的感官类别固定映射，无法捕捉感官语言表达的语境依赖性，因此需要一种更精准、语境敏感的方法来提取和分析消费者评论中的感官信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感官营销理论（感官维度是消费者评价的核心）；语境依赖性理论（感官语言的含义随语境变化）；评价框架理论（不同感官模态可能承担不同的评价功能——享乐评价vs.诊断性线索）。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLM）进行语境敏感的感官识别；与人类编码者和基于词典的方法进行对比验证；基于82,350条真实餐厅评论数据进行实证分析；通过回归分析考察感官模态与评分之间的关系及其语境调节作用。
AI.findings: LLM在识别感官信息方面比人类编码者和词典方法具有更高的可靠性，能捕捉隐含和语境依赖的感官表达。不同感官模态与评分的关联存在显著差异，但这些差异主要由评价语境解释——某些感官主要用于表达正面享乐评价，另一些则更多作为负面评价中的诊断性线索出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利用LLM进行语境敏感感官分析的新方法框架；揭示了感官模态在消费者评价中的不同功能角色（享乐评价 vs. 诊断线索）；将感官分析从简单的识别层面推进到理解其评价作用的层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和营销人员提供了一种更精准的消费者感官体验分析方法；帮助理解不同感官属性在消费者评价中的不同作用，从而优化产品和服务设计；该方法可推广到不同产品类别的消费者文本分析中。

title: Brand Legibility: A Construct for Building Brand Equity in AI-Mediated Markets

detail.title: Brand Legibility: A Construct for Building Brand Equity in AI-Mediated Markets

This relationship is also disclosed in Section 5 of the manuscript. The author's affiliation with Fundação Getulio Vargas (FGV) as Visiting Professor and with Wyse Brand Intelligence as Founder is institutional only and did not include dedicated research funding for this manuscript.

detail.abstract: Brand erasure (Figueira, 2026a, 2026b) named the failure mode of brand theory in AI-mediated markets-the systematic suppression of brand identity inside synthesized answers and completed agentic actions. This paper develops the corresponding positive construct: Brand Legibility, the degree to which a brand is recognizable, parseable, and attributable by the AI systems that mediate consumer experience. We position Brand Legibility as the latent-substrate counterpart of brand salience (Romaniuk & Sharp, 2004) and the operational property whose absence produces erasure. We introduce the Semantic Equity Index (SEI) as the quantitative measure of legibility and the Brand Legibility Framework as the operating model that integrates Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, and Agentic Optimization as three coordinated layers. We close with the Brand Erasure Audit as the measurement protocol that operationalizes the framework, and with implications for brand-equity theory, marketing organizations, and the governance of attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"品牌可读性"（Brand Legibility）作为AI中介市场中品牌理论的正向构念，用以对抗品牌擦除（Brand Erasure）现象，并引入语义公平指数（SEI）作为量化指标，构建了涵盖答案引擎优化、生成引擎优化与代理优化的品牌可读性框架，以及品牌擦除审计协议。
AI.research_question: 在AI中介的市场环境中，品牌如何保持可识别、可解析与可归因？如何量化并管理品牌在AI系统中的可见性与归属性？
AI.motivation: AI生成内容（如合成答案、代理行为）系统性地压制了品牌身份，导致"品牌擦除"现象，传统品牌理论无法解释和应对这一失效模式，亟需建构新的正向理论工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌可读性理论（Brand Legibility）；品牌擦除理论（Brand Erasure）；品牌显著性（Brand Salience）的潜在基底对应物；语义公平指数（SEI）；品牌可读性框架（三层：答案引擎优化、生成引擎优化、代理优化）。
AI.method: 概念建构与理论推演，提出量化指标（SEI）和操作化协议（品牌擦除审计）。
AI.findings: 品牌可读性是品牌显著性的潜在基底构念，其缺失直接导致品牌擦除；SEI可量化可读性；三层优化框架可系统应对AI中介市场中的品牌可见性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将品牌理论拓展至AI中介市场；提出品牌可读性作为品牌显著性的潜在基底构念；建立品牌擦除与品牌可读性的理论对偶关系；为品牌权益理论提供AI时代的补充框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供品牌擦除审计作为可操作化测量协议；为营销组织提供答案引擎优化、生成引擎优化和代理优化的三层操作模型；为AI时代的品牌归因治理提供实践指导。

title: 'An Empirical Analysis of the Effectiveness of Digital Marketing Strategies in the UAE Real Estate Business Sector'
affiliations: Manipal GlobalNxt University, Malaysia and Manipal GlobalNxt University Malaysia

detail.title: 'An Empirical Analysis of the Effectiveness of Digital Marketing Strategies in the UAE Real Estate Business Sector'
detail.abstract: In UAE, property developers, real estate agencies, and brokers, leverage digital platforms to showcase their listings, targeting local, and international buyers and tenants. As of January 2025, active social media identities in the UAE are reported at ~11.3 million, approximately 100% of the population, underscoring the pervasiveness of digital touch points across segments and nationalities (Data Reportal, 2025). The core problem is that UAE real estate businesses lack empirical clarity regarding the actual effectiveness of digital marketing strategies. Therefore, there is a clear need for systematic empirical search to examine the impact of digital marketing concepts in the UAE real estate sector. This study adopted a cross-sectional survey research design, where data were collected at a single point of time in the year 2025 from business customers operating across various segments of the UAE real estate sector. The survey was administered through multiple channels, including email distribution, social media platforms, and direct communication through personal visits or phone calls and valid data were collected from 330 respondents. One sample t-test was conducted to test the hypotheses formulated for the study. The results proved that the all the four variables under study, viz., Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Social Media Marketing (SMM), Content Marketing (CTM), and E-mail Marketing (EMM) are high-performing, with SMM being the most significant driver among the tested variables. By 2026, UAE real estate marketing has matured into an integrated, high-tech system, where SMM drives high-intent sales, and immersive content is essential for trust. The UAE real estate market keeps moving fast, and in 2026 social media sits at the centre of property search and sale. It connects with buyers from Asia, Europe, and GCC. Social Media makes it easier to showcase properties clearly, and it allows quickreal conversations with potential buyers.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2025年对330名阿联酋房地产行业商业客户的横截面调查，采用单样本t检验发现：搜索引擎优化（SEO）、社交媒体营销（SMM）、内容营销（CTM）和电子邮件营销（EMM）四种数字营销策略均表现高效，其中SMM是驱动效果最显著的变量。到2026年，阿联酋房地产营销已演变为以社交媒体为核心、沉浸式内容为信任基础的集成化高科技体系。
AI.research_question: 在阿联酋房地产行业中，不同的数字营销策略（SEO、SMM、CTM、EMM）对商业客户的有效性如何？哪一类策略表现最为突出？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋房地产行业虽然广泛使用数字平台（社交媒体活跃用户约1130万，接近人口100%），但缺乏关于数字营销策略实际有效性的实证证据，存在明确的实证研究缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字营销效能理论，将四种核心数字营销策略（SEO、SMM、CTM、EMM）作为自变量，以商业客户感知的有效性为因变量，构建评估框架。
AI.method: 采用横截面调查研究设计，2025年单次收集数据，通过邮件、社交媒体、实地走访/电话等多渠道发放问卷，回收330份有效数据，运用单样本t检验进行假设检验。
AI.findings: 四种数字营销策略均被证明为高绩效变量，其中SMM（社交媒体营销）是驱动效果最强的因素。到2026年，阿联酋房地产营销已形成以SMM驱动高意向销售、沉浸式内容建立信任的集成化高科技体系，社交媒体成为房产搜索和销售的核心渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字营销理论在房地产垂直行业的应用提供了来自阿联酋市场的实证证据，验证了社交媒体营销在新兴市场中相对于传统数字营销策略的差异化优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋房地产企业提供了明确的数字营销投资优先级：优先布局社交媒体营销，同时整合SEO、内容营销和邮件营销；揭示了面向亚洲、欧洲和海湾国家买家时社交媒体的跨区域连接价值。

title: NEMESIS-Edge: A Neuromorphic Multimodal Edge Architecture or Energy-Efficient Real-Time Perception in UAV and Healthcare Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: NEMESIS-Edge: A Neuromorphic Multimodal Edge Architecture or Energy-Efficient Real-Time Perception in UAV and Healthcare Systems

keywords.keywords: Neuromorphic computingEdge AIMultimodal perceptionEnergy-efficient AIReal-time inferenceUAV systemsHealthcare AISpiking neural networks

detail.abstract: Neuromorphic computing has emerged as a promising paradigm forenabling energy-efficient and low-latency intelligence at the edge, partic-ularly for applications requiring real-time multimodal perception. Thispaper presents NEMESIS-Edge, a novel neuromorphic multimodal edgearchitecture designed to integrate heterogeneous sensory data under strictresource constraints. The proposed framework leverages spiking neuralnetworks (SNNs) for event-driven processing, significantly reducing com-putational overhead compared to conventional deep learning approaches.At the core of the architecture is SpikeFusion-X, a spike-domain multi-modal fusion algorithm that preserves temporal dynamics while enablingefficient cross-modal interaction. The framework supports multiple sens-ing modalities, including RGB visual data, polarimetric infrared sensing,and physiological signals, making it suitable for both UAV-based percep-tion and healthcare monitoring applications. A hardware-aware designstrategy is incorporated to ensure compatibility with neuromorphic pro-cessors and edge devices by considering sparsity, quantization, and mem-ory efficiency constraints. Experimental evaluation is conducted using a benchmark-driven method-ology aligned with emerging neuromorphic evaluation standards. Resultsdemonstrate that NEMESIS-Edge achieves up to 6× lower latency and 8×higher energy efficiency compared to baseline approaches while maintain-ing competitive perception accuracy. Additional ablation and robustnessanalyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed spike-domainfusion mechanism under heterogeneous sensing conditions.Overall, NEMESIS-Edge provides a scalable and efficient frameworkfor real-time neuromorphic edge intelligence across diverse multimodalapplication domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为NEMESIS-Edge的新型神经形态多模态边缘架构，通过脉冲神经网络（SNN）和SpikeFusion-X脉冲域融合算法，在严格资源约束下实现低延迟、高能效的多模态感知，适用于无人机感知和医疗监测等场景。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限的边缘设备上实现高效的多模态感知融合，同时保持低延迟和高能效？
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习方案计算开销大、能耗高，难以满足边缘实时多模态感知的严格资源约束；神经形态计算虽具潜力，但缺乏面向多模态融合的专用边缘架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）的事件驱动处理理论；脉冲域多模态融合算法（SpikeFusion-X）；硬件感知设计策略（稀疏性、量化、内存效率）。
AI.method: 设计SpikeFusion-X脉冲域融合算法以保持时间动态并实现跨模态交互；采用硬件感知设计兼容神经形态处理器；基于基准驱动的方法进行实验评估。
AI.findings: 相比基线方法，NEMESIS-Edge延迟降低6倍，能效提升8倍，同时保持有竞争力的感知精度；消融和鲁棒性分析验证了脉冲域融合机制的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了脉冲域多模态融合算法SpikeFusion-X，保留时间动态实现高效跨模态交互；为神经形态边缘计算提供了可扩展的架构设计范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了支持RGB视觉、偏振红外和生理信号等多模态的实时边缘智能系统；在无人机感知和医疗监测等实际应用中具有高能效、低延迟的部署价值。

title: Energy and carbon routing in hydrothermal lignocellulosic biomass conversion: an uncertainty-aware machine-learning framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Energy and carbon routing in hydrothermal lignocellulosic biomass conversion: an uncertainty-aware machine-learning framework
detail.abstract: Reliable assessment of hydrothermal lignocellulosic biomass conversion requires quantitative prediction of how feedstock mass, chemical energy, and carbon partition among bio-oil, solid residues, aqueous products, and gases under heterogeneous feedstock, solvent, catalyst, and severity conditions. We constructed a harmonized database of 3,693 HTL/HTC experiments from 187 scientific papers and 433 different biomass samples, with temperatures up to ∼ 600 ◦C and maximum residence times of up to 1,200 min. From this literature-scale dataset, we developed an uncertainty-aware machine-learning framework for predicting mass partitioning, energy and carbon allocation, and higher heating value (HHV) of condensed phases. Among the tree-ensemble regression methods examined, Random Forest (RF) provided the most stable cross-target compromise, with test R2 values for product yields around 0.8, energy/carbon allocation metrics between 0.8 and 0.9, and bio-oil HHV around 0.7 with root-mean-squared error ∼ 2–3 MJkg−1. The model recovers established severity, solvent, and composition trends while identifying regions where predictions are well supported or weakly constrained. SHAP attributions are interpreted as model-conditional associations: liquid-phase outcomes depend strongly on solvent and operating conditions, whereas solid-phase HHVs are more associated with feedstock carbon and ash content. Ensemble and conformal uncertainty methods distinguish relative epistemic uncertainty from calibrated scenario bounds. The framework is intended for uncertainty-aware process screening, scenario bounding, and experimental prioritization rather than unqualified point optimization in poorly represented regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含3,693个 hydrothermal 实验数据的数据库，开发了基于随机森林的不确定性感知机器学习框架，用于预测木质纤维素生物质水热转化中的质量、能量和碳分配，模型对产物产率的测试R²约0.8，能量/碳分配指标在0.8-0.9之间，生物油HHV约0.7。
AI.research_question: 如何实现水热/水炭化木质纤维素生物质转化过程中质量、化学能和碳在生物油、固体残渣、水相产物和气体之间的定量预测？
AI.motivation: 可靠评估水热/水炭化生物质转化需要定量预测不同条件下的产物分配，但目前缺乏整合多种原料、溶剂、催化剂和操作条件的统一预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机森林（Random Forest）集成回归方法；SHAP特征归因分析；集成与共形不确定性量化方法。
AI.method: 从187篇科学论文中收集3,693个实验数据，构建统一数据库，涵盖433种不同生物质样本；采用多种树集成回归方法进行建模，最终选定随机森林；使用SHAP解释模型预测，并应用集成和共形不确定性方法进行不确定性量化。
AI.findings: 随机森林在产物产率预测上测试R²约0.8，能量/碳分配指标0.8-0.9，生物油HHV约0.7（RMSE约2-3 MJ/kg）；液相产物强烈依赖于溶剂和操作条件，固相HHV更多与原料碳含量和灰分含量相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了不确定性感知的机器学习预测框架，区分了认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）与校准情景边界；提供了模型条件关联的SHAP归因解释方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水热生物质转化过程提供不确定性感知的工艺筛选、情景边界界定和实验优先级排序工具，避免在数据稀疏区域进行无条件的点优化。

title: ASSESSMENTS OF THE PRIMARY FACTORS AFFECTING DRIVING SPEED AND THE VIOLATION OF THE SPEED LIMIT BY DRIVERS IN ADDIS ABABA
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: ASSESSMENTS OF THE PRIMARY FACTORS AFFECTING DRIVING SPEED AND THE VIOLATION OF THE SPEED LIMIT BY DRIVERS IN ADDIS ABABA
detail.abstract: Purpose: The primary aim of this research is to establish the key factors influencing driving speed and the level of compliance among drivers with posted speed limits (PSLs) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.Design/Methodology/Approach: - A mixed-methods design was employed. Spot speed data were collected on various types of roads (arterials, sub-arterials, collectors, and locals), and 450 drivers were surveyed using convenience sampling. Multiple linear regression was utilized to investigate the effects on operating speed, while ordinal logistic regression modeled self-reported offenses as a function of driver demographics and attitudes.Findings: Results show that operating speeds are influenced by roadway characteristics (e.g., pedestrian activity, number of lanes) (p < 0.05). Driver demographics (gender, age, experience) are the primary predictors of violations. A basic knowledge-behavior gap exists, with most drivers being knowledgeable about speeding hazards but still violating limits. Commercial drivers most prominently cite income pressure as the primary reason for non-compliance, as adherence to PSLs would reduce their daily income.Practical Implications: The findings suggest that traditional safety countermeasures are insufficient. Multi-dimensional interventions incorporating engineering strategies (e.g., traffic calming), selective enforcement, and strategies to mitigate the economic pressures faced by commercial drivers need to be implemented by policymakers and traffic managers. Ignoring the economic dimension of speeding will compromise the effectiveness of safety programs.Originality/Value: This paper presents a novel, evidence-based perspective on speeding in a developing urban context by quantifying the significant role of economic pressure on commercial driver behavior, a factor that has been considerably overlooked in traditional safety research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法调查埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴驾驶员超速行为的影响因素，发现道路特征影响运行速度，而驾驶员人口统计特征（性别、年龄、经验）是违规行为的主要预测因子。商业驾驶员因经济压力（遵守限速会减少日收入）而普遍违规，存在知-行鸿沟。研究提出需要结合工程策略、执法和缓解经济压力的多维干预措施。
AI.research_question: 影响亚的斯亚贝巴驾驶员行驶速度和对规定限速（PSLs）遵守程度的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统交通安全研究多关注发达国家，对发展中国家城市背景下驾驶员超速行为的复杂影响因素（尤其是经济压力）缺乏系统性实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识-行为差距理论；经济压力与驾驶行为关系；道路特征对运行速度的影响机制
AI.method: 混合方法设计：在主次干道、集散道路和本地道路上收集点速度数据，并对450名驾驶员进行便利抽样问卷调查。采用多元线性回归分析运行速度影响因素，序次逻辑回归模型分析自我报告违章行为与驾驶员人口统计特征及态度之间的关系。
AI.findings: （1）运行速度受道路特征（如行人活动、车道数）显著影响（p < 0.05）；（2）驾驶员人口统计特征（性别、年龄、驾驶经验）是违规行为的主要预测因子；（3）存在知识-行为差距，大多数驾驶员明知超速危害但仍违规；（4）商业驾驶员将收入压力作为不遵守限速的首要原因，遵守限速会减少其日收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了经济压力对发展中国家商业驾驶员超速行为的显著作用，揭示了传统超速研究中被忽视的经济维度，拓展了驾驶行为理论在发展中国家城市背景下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出多维干预策略：工程措施（如交通静化）、选择性执法，以及缓解商业驾驶员经济压力的配套政策。指出忽视经济维度将危及交通安全项目的有效性。

title: Unbundling Extension Access, Cassava Variety Adoption, and Household Food Security in Nigeria: Evidence from the General Household Survey
affiliations: University of Ibadan Ibadan Nigeria and University of Ibadan, Ibadan, Nigeria

detail.title: Unbundling Extension Access, Cassava Variety Adoption, and Household Food Security in Nigeria: Evidence from the General Household Survey
detail.abstract: Agricultural extension systems in sub-Saharan Africa are increasingly evolving, yet evidence on whether access to extension services generates distinct welfare effects and through which pathways remain limited. This study operationalises extension access as via government agents, formal non-government sources, peer and cooperative networks, and digital platforms. It examines their independent effects on improved cassava variety adoption and household food security among 1,524 cassava-farming households in Nigeria, using nationally representative data from the General Household Survey–Panel Wave 5 (2023/24). Employing survey-weighted probit and ordinary least squares models alongside bootstrap causal mediation analysis, the total effect of extension access on food security is decomposed into an indirect component operating through improved variety adoption and a direct component reflecting all other pathways. First, no extension channel robustly increases improved cassava variety adoption; peer and cooperative extension is associated with a significant reduction in adoption probability of 14.4 percentage points. Second, extension channels improve household dietary diversity significantly as each additional channel accessed is associated with 0.25 additional food groups at the planting wave and 0.39 at the harvest wave. However, the proportion of this effect mediated through variety adoption is consistently below one percent across all specifications, indicating that direct knowledge and market access pathways dominate. Third, female-headed households have near-zero extension access across all channels. These results challenge the use of variety adoption as the primary metric for extension impact evaluation, identify direct agronomic knowledge transfer and market access as the dominant welfare-generating mechanisms of extension.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用尼日利亚1524户木薯农户的全国代表性数据，分析了政府、非政府组织、同行合作与数字平台四种农业推广渠道对改良品种采纳和家庭粮食安全的独立影响。结果显示：推广服务并未显著促进品种采纳，反而同行合作推广使采纳概率降低14.4个百分点；但推广渠道显著改善了饮食多样性（每增加一个渠道，种植季增加0.25个食物组，收获季增加0.39个），且这一效应几乎不通过品种采纳中介（<1%），而是通过直接知识传递和市场准入实现；女性户主家庭的推广服务获取几乎为零。
AI.research_question: 农业推广服务获取是否产生差异化的福利效应？其作用路径是什么？不同推广渠道（政府、非政府、同行合作、数字平台）对改良品种采纳和家庭粮食安全有何独立影响？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲农业推广体系正在演变，但关于推广服务获取是否产生差异化福利效应以及通过何种路径实现的研究证据仍然有限。现有研究多将推广服务视为单一变量，未区分不同渠道的独立效应，也缺乏对作用机制（品种采纳 vs. 直接知识传递/市场准入）的因果分解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业推广服务通过两条路径影响粮食安全：间接路径（通过促进改良品种采纳提高产量）和直接路径（通过知识传递和市场信息提升农业实践和资源配置效率）。研究运用因果中介分析框架，将推广服务对粮食安全的总效应分解为以品种采纳为中介的间接效应和包含知识传递、市场准入等在内的直接效应。
AI.method: 使用尼日利亚综合家庭调查面板数据（2023/24年，第5波），样本量为1524户木薯种植家庭。采用调查加权probit模型和普通最小二乘模型估计推广渠道对品种采纳和粮食安全的影响，并运用bootstrap因果中介分析方法将总效应分解为间接效应（通过品种采纳）和直接效应。
AI.findings: 1. 没有任何推广渠道能稳健地提高改良品种采纳率；同行和合作推广反而使采纳概率显著降低14.4个百分点。2. 推广渠道显著改善家庭饮食多样性：每增加一个推广渠道，种植季多摄入0.25个食物组，收获季多摄入0.39个食物组。3. 品种采纳的中介效应占比始终低于1%，直接知识传递和市场准入路径占主导。4. 女性户主家庭在所有推广渠道的获取率几乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了以品种采纳率作为推广效果评估主要指标的传统范式，证明推广服务的主要福利效应并非通过品种采纳实现。2. 系统区分了推广服务的间接路径（品种采纳）和直接路径（知识传递、市场准入），并实证量化了二者的相对贡献，揭示了直接路径的主导地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为撒哈拉以南非洲农业推广体系改革提供实证依据：应超越单一的品种推广目标，注重直接知识传递和市场准入功能。2. 发现同行合作推广可能产生负面效应（降低品种采纳），提示需优化推广网络设计。3. 揭示女性户主家庭面临严重的推广服务排斥，为制定包容性推广政策提供指向。

title: Turboexpander or Regulator? Probabilistic Exergy Destruction Mapping with Controlled Preheating for Natural Gas Pressure Reduction – a Monte Carlo study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Turboexpander or Regulator? Probabilistic Exergy Destruction Mapping with Controlled Preheating for Natural Gas Pressure Reduction – a Monte Carlo study
detail.abstract: Natural gas pressure-reduction stations conventionally dissipate the exergy of the incoming gas through throttling valves. Replacing these valves with turboexpanders can recover useful work, but the need for preheating to avoid hydrate formation creates a trade-off that may offset this benefit. This study presents a rigorous second-law comparison of regulator and turboexpander systems using a controlled, minimum-energy preheating strategy. All thermodynamic properties are computed with the AGA-8 equation of state to ensure high accuracy. A novel comparative exergy destruction parameter Δ is defined, and three operational scenarios are identified. A Monte Carlo simulation with 50,000 samples spanning realistic inlet pressures (300–1000 psi), temperatures (10–50 °C), and heater efficiencies (0.50–0.95) maps the probabilistic performance. Results show that the turboexpander system destroys less total exergy than the regulator system in 30.7% of the investigated conditions. The preheater contributes, on average, 78.1% of the turboexpander system’s total exergy destruction, compared with only 4.3% for the regulator. An optimal inlet pressure exists for each inlet temperature that minimizes Δ; this inlet pressure increases with inlet temperature up to about 500 psi. The study provides a clear decision map: the turboexpander is second-law superior only in a well-defined region of moderate pressure, high inlet temperature, and high heater efficiency. These findings offer a quantitative basis for selecting stations where turboexpander installation is thermodynamically justified.

AI.tldr: 本文通过严格的第二定律分析，比较了天然气调压站中传统节流阀与涡轮膨胀机系统的性能。研究发现，只有在中等压力、高入口温度和高加热器效率的特定条件下，涡轮膨胀机才在热力学上优于节流阀系统。加热器平均贡献了涡轮膨胀机系统总火用损失的78.1%，而节流阀系统仅为4.3%。基于5万次蒙特卡洛模拟，涡轮膨胀机仅在30.7%的条件下火用损失更小。
AI.research_question: 在天然气调压站中，用涡轮膨胀机替代传统节流阀是否在热力学（第二定律）意义上更优？
AI.motivation: 天然气调压站传统使用节流阀造成大量火用损失，涡轮膨胀机可回收有用功，但需要预加热以防止水合物形成，带来新的能量消耗。需要系统性比较两种方案的实际热力学性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第二定律（火用）分析；AGA-8状态方程；蒙特卡洛模拟；定义新的比较性火用破坏参数Δ。
AI.method: 使用AGA-8状态方程计算热力学性质；定义火用破坏参数Δ；进行5万次蒙特卡洛模拟，覆盖入口压力300-1000 psi、温度10-50°C、加热器效率0.50-0.95；识别三种运行场景。
AI.findings: （1）涡轮膨胀机系统仅在30.7%的条件下火用损失小于节流阀系统；（2）加热器贡献涡轮膨胀机系统78.1%的火用损失（节流阀仅4.3%）；（3）存在使Δ最小的最优入口压力，且该压力随温度升高至约500 psi；（4）涡轮膨胀机仅在中等压力、高入口温度、高加热器效率区域具有第二定律优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的比较性火用破坏参数Δ，为两种系统的热力学比较提供了量化工具；基于严格的状态方程和概率模拟，建立了系统化的决策地图。
AI.practical_contributions: 为天然气行业提供了定量选择涡轮膨胀机安装站点的热力学依据，明确了哪些工况下替换节流阀才具有实际效益，避免了盲目投资。

title: Is Circular the new Resilient? Rethinking EU Performance through a New Sustainable Resilience Index
affiliations: University of Prešov and University of Prešov

detail.title: Is Circular the new Resilient? Rethinking EU Performance through a New Sustainable Resilience Index
detail.abstract: As European countries face increasing environmental pressures, shifting geopolitical dynamics, and growing concerns over material dependency, the concept of sustainable resilience is gaining prominence in EU policy and academic discourse. Although the circular economy (CE) is widely recognised as a strategic response to resource and climate challenges, the empirical linkages between CE and economic resilience remain under-explored. This study constructs a Sustainable Resilience Index (SRI) for EU-26 countries over the period 2010–2022, integrating indicators across environmental pressures, circularity, innovation, and global economic integration. Using principal component analysis, the index captures multi-dimensional systemic resilience. The results reveal substantial cross-country heterogeneity, with SRI scores ranging from near-zero in Romania to above 90 in Denmark and Luxembourg, and a pronounced north-west to south-east geographic gradient persisting throughout the observation period. Results demonstrate that productive and innovation capacities exert stronger influence on the SRI than circularity indicators. This suggests that while CE contributes to long-term resilience through reduced material dependence and import exposure, its role remains secondary to broader structural capacities. A gradual convergence in SRI scores is observed, driven primarily by improvements among lower-ranked countries, though the absolute gap between leaders and laggards remains substantial. The study offers a replicable framework for tracking sustainable resilience and provides policy-relevant insights for aligning CE strategies with structural capacity building, place-based development, and the EU's open strategic autonomy agenda.

AI.tldr: 本研究为欧盟26国构建了可持续韧性指数（SRI），发现各国在环境压力、循环经济、创新和全球整合方面的韧性差异显著，呈现西北至东南的地理梯度，且生产和创新能力对韧性的贡献大于循环经济指标。
AI.research_question: 循环经济（CE）与可持续韧性之间的实证联系是什么？欧盟各国在可持续韧性方面存在怎样的异质性和收敛趋势？
AI.motivation: 尽管循环经济被广泛视为应对资源和气候挑战的战略，但其与经济韧性之间的实证关系尚未得到充分探索。此外，欧洲面临环境压力加剧、地缘政治变化和材料依赖性增强等挑战，亟需衡量可持续韧性的综合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续韧性概念、循环经济理论、系统韧性理论、主成分分析法（PCA）
AI.method: 构建可持续韧性指数（SRI），整合环境压力、循环性、创新和全球经济一体化等维度指标，运用主成分分析法（PCA）对2010-2022年欧盟26国数据进行多维度系统性韧性测量。
AI.findings: （1）各国SRI得分差异显著，罗马尼亚接近零，丹麦和卢森堡超过90；（2）呈现明显的西北欧向东南欧地理梯度；（3）生产能力和创新能力对SRI的贡献大于循环性指标；（4）存在SRI得分逐渐收敛的趋势，主要由低排名国家的改善驱动，但领先国与落后国的绝对差距仍然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建了循环经济与可持续韧性之间的实证联系，揭示了CE在长期韧性中的作用（通过减少材料依赖和进口风险）相对有限，为理解可持续韧性的多维构成提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制的可持续韧性追踪框架，为欧盟政策制定者提供了将循环经济战略与结构性能力建设、地方化发展和开放战略自主议程相结合的政策洞见。

title: From Hand Detachment to Mind Detachment A Conceptual Framework for Understanding Alienation in the Age of AI

detail.title: From Hand Detachment to Mind Detachment A Conceptual Framework for Understanding Alienation in the Age of AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nil
declarations.funderStatement: Nil

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a conceptual distinction between two forms of detachment that have been conflated in critical theories of modernity and capitalism. Hand detachment refers to the process by which tools—information, resources, capital—leave the immediate control of their creators.
